a9c532d9.title: Technical Program Manager
a9c532d9.description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
 At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.
   

  

 AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high\-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go\-to\-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.
   

  

**SENIOR PROGRAM MANAGER**
* THE ROLE:


 As a SoC Program Manager, you will lead end\-to\-end execution across complex System\-on\-Chip (SoC/ASIC) development programs from architecture through tapeout and post\-silicon phases. You will drive program milestones, manage cross\-functional dependencies across IP teams (CPU/GPU/NOC/DDR/SoC subsystems), and ensure alignment across RTL, PD, DFT, firmware, validation, and platform teams. You will be responsible for planning, tracking, reporting, and risk management across all phases of SoC execution, including architecture, design convergence, validation, tapeout, and silicon enablement, while ensuring predictable delivery and high\-quality outcomes.
   

  

**The Person**
 You bring strong execution discipline, structured program management, and cross\-functional leadership. You partner seamlessly with architects, IP owners, RTL, PD, DFT, firmware, validation, and external vendors to drive convergence, resolve dependencies, and maintain schedule integrity. You understand system\-level architecture, SoC integration challenges, milestones (e.g., architecture, RTL feature completion, physical design readiness, validation readiness, engineering change order (ECO) phase, tapeout) and the full lifecycle of complex SoC programs, with the ability to drive alignment across geographically distributed teams. You ensure execution is on\-time, within cost, and manage scope changes. As a Program Manager you will drive AMD product solution deliverables and alignment with customers’ platforms to ensure highest level customer satisfaction throughout their product lifecycle. You proactively involve team members in planning, decision\-making and execution efforts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Program Planning \& Execution
* Define, structure, and drive end\-to\-end SoC program plans in alignment with architecture, design, and tapeout milestones.
* Ensure requirements are clearly defined and integrated into design, validation, and silicon execution plans.
* Create and maintain detailed schedules covering:
* Architecture definition and high\-level design readiness
* IP integration and subsystem convergence
* Design milestones (architecture, RTL feature completion, physical design readiness, validation readiness, engineering change order (ECO) phase, tapeout)
* Track progress across IP teams (CPU, NOC, DDR, SoC subsystems, etc.) and ensure timely milestone completion.
* Drive disciplined execution through structured action tracking, meeting cadences, and program reviews.
* Drive milestone checklist compliance and readiness reviews for key program exits.
* Manage resource planning, onboarding, and execution tracking across internal teams and external vendors (ODC/CW engagement).
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with architecture, RTL, PD, DFT, firmware, validation, and system engineering teams to resolve cross\-domain dependencies.
* Drive convergence forums (IP\-SOC, subsystem syncs, CFT reviews) to ensure alignment across all stakeholders.
* Track and manage detailed schedules and deliverable lists covering:
* Cross\-IP dependency tracking (interfaces, fuse mapping, metal stack, etc.)
* Validation readiness (pre\-silicon and post\-silicon)
* Silicon bring\-up and platform readiness
* Risk \& Issue Management
* Identify program risks early (schedule slips, dependency gaps, design readiness, vendor execution issues).
* Drive mitigation plans with clear ownership; escalate proactively to leadership when required.
* Track cross\-IP blockers and ensure timely resolution through structured follow\-up and governance.
* Manage backlog of open items, track closure rates, and ensure high\-priority issues are driven to closure.
* Reporting \& Governance
* Collect, analyze, and publish program status and execution metrics (milestone health, dependency closure, risk status).
* Maintain dashboards and trackers using Jira, Confluence, Excel, PowerBI, and internal tools.
* Provide concise, executive\-level weekly / monthly updates highlighting risks, progress, and key asks.
* Run structured governance cadences including CFT forums, leadership reviews, and cross\-team syncs.
* Process \& Methodology Improvement
* Drive improvements in program execution frameworks, action tracking, and cross\-team coordination.
* Introduce structured templates for meeting notes, tracking, and reporting to improve clarity and efficiency.
* Streamline workflows to reduce noise, eliminate duplication, and improve execution predictability.
* Implement automation for reporting, tracking, and data consolidation using tools like MS Project, Jira, and scripting.
* Leverage AI for improving execution efficiency across tracking, reporting, and workflows
* AI focused execution mindset
* Focus on using AI to automate existing processes and improve execution efficiency
* Hands\-on experience with AI tools
* Experience using AI with Excel, PowerPoint, and Jira is a plus


**Preferred Experience**
* Must have experience in SoC/ASIC product cycles and understanding of architecture, integration, validation, and silicon bring\-up phases.
* Strong familiarity with SoC / IP execution flows:
* Architecture to tapeout lifecycle (standard RTL and netlist\-based milestones)
* IP integration and dependency management
* Pre\-silicon and post\-silicon execution flows
* System\-level bring\-up and platform readiness
* Detail\-oriented, self\-driven with a strong sense of pride and ownership.
* Proficiency in project management tools (JIRA, Confluence, PowerBI, Excel, MS Project, AI tools).
* Strong organizational, problem\-solving, interpersonal, presentation, written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to build relationships and work effectively as a self\-starter and as part of a team.
* Prior experience driving large multi\-site or multi\-vendor engagements is desirable.
* People management experience is desirable.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to handle all levels of interaction, including executive level.
* Horizontal leadership/Matrix management experience.
* Technical program management and customer relationship management.


**Academic Credentials**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer/Electrical/Electronics Engineering
   

  

 Formal project management education, PMP / Scrum Master
   

  

*Benefits offered are described:* 
 AMD benefits at a glance.
   

  

*AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third\-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.*

**Job Overview**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 We are seeking an experienced and driven
 **IT HCM Solution Architect** 
 to join our team in Mumbai. This role is responsible for designing and delivering Oracle HCM Cloud solutions across HR and the wider ERP ecosystem. The position will play a key role in a major enterprise transformation, including the modernization of core systems. The successful candidate will work closely with HR, IT, Finance, ERP teams, and implementation partners to design scalable solutions, ensure seamless system integration, and support end\-to\-end project delivery. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a global digital transformation while working on complex HCM and ERP integration initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead Oracle HCM Cloud solution design across Core HR, Talent, Compensation, Absence, Time \& Labor, and Benefits.
* Design scalable HCM solutions aligned with business requirements and technology standards.
* Ensure effective integration between Oracle HCM, Oracle ERP, and other enterprise systems.
* Act as a liaison between HCM and ERP implementation teams.
* Support solution lifecycle activities including design, proof of concepts (POCs), testing, deployment, and post go\-live support.
* Develop and document solution architecture, data flows, and integration requirements.
* Build and support integrations using HCM Extracts, HCM Data Loader (HDL), REST/SOAP APIs, and Oracle Integration Cloud.
* Collaborate with HR, IT, Finance, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and recommend solutions.
* Provide guidance to project teams, vendors, consultants, and senior stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with Oracle Cloud best practices and solution governance standards.


**Skills**
* Strong expertise in Oracle HCM Cloud modules (Core HR, Talent, Compensation, Absence, Time \& Labor).
* Good understanding of Oracle ERP and its integration with HCM (Finance, Payroll, Projects).
* Experience with HCM Extracts, HDL, Fast Formulas, and REST/SOAP APIs.
* Knowledge of Oracle Integration Cloud and enterprise integration frameworks.
* Ability to design end\-to\-end HCM solutions in complex environments.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
* Problem\-solving mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of experience, with strong focus on Oracle HCM.
* Minimum 3 full lifecycle Oracle HCM Cloud implementations.
* Experience working with vendors, consultants, or implementation partners.
* Oracle HCM Cloud certification (preferred).
* Experience with Oracle ERP Cloud, security, and integration tools (preferred).

 When you join Weatherford, you instantly feel connected to something bigger – a community that is grounded by our core values and driven to create innovative solutions for our customers. We celebrate each other’s successes, grow together, and learn from each other constantly. Individually, we are impressive. Together, we are unstoppable. We are One Weatherford.

2f5aa24a.description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 APAC Solution Consulting team is expanding into India! We are hiring GTM roles including Presales Solution Consultant (Planning) to grow our presence in the country.
   

  

 More than 700 global corporations and several millions of end\-users are users of Workday products in India. We are building on this strong base and work closely with our partners to bring our solutions, to the local organisations! We believe there is an increased opportunity to expand our Financial and Workforce Planning business portfolio. Increasingly, organisations that want to transform the way they operate are replacing legacy systems with Workday’s SaaS Enterprise Management applications.
   

  

 If you are a Presales Solution Consultant with domain expertise in Enterprise Planning \& Analytics and have industry experience, who is passionate about changing the way people work in this age of AI, we’d love to speak to you.
   

  

 As a member of our diverse and skilled Presales team, you will sit at the intersection of Sales, Product Management, Consulting, and Marketing. Your mission is to bring the value of Workday solutions to life, showcasing how the office of the CFO and CHRO can be revolutionized through next\-generation SaaS planning and consolidation applications.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Workday is looking for a senior\-level technical professional with deep expertise in Enterprise Planning and Analytics. You will leverage your product and industry knowledge to provide functional expertise throughout the sales process for our largest enterprise prospects.
   

  

 You will lead discovery workshops with prospective customers to uncover business requirements and value. You will provide authoritative overview and deep\-dive product demonstrations and position the unique value of Workday Adaptive Planning. You will conduct executive\-level presentations and provide trusted advice and mentorship as a planning subject matter expert. We also assist in responding to RFPs, participate in Workday events such as webinars, customer forums, and industry conferences and tradeshows.
   

  

***Key Responsibilities:***
* Strategic Discovery: Lead workshops with prospective customers to uncover business requirements, current pain points, and potential value.
* High\-Impact Demonstrations/Presentations: Deliver authoritative deep\-dive product demonstrations and executive\-level presentations that position the unique value of Workday Adaptive Planning.
* Technical Excellence: Develop and champion Workday\-based solutions, which may include rapid prototyping, creating mini\-applications, or delivering complex Proofs of Concept (POC).
* Trusted Advisor: Build deep relationships with C\-level stakeholders—specifically the office of the CFO—offering mentorship and credible subject matter expertise.
* Sales Partnership: Collaborate with Account Executives to lead RFP/RFI responses and develop winning value propositions.


**About You**
**Basic Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of overall professional experience, including at least 5 years working with Finance Planning, Budgeting and Forecasting systems in enterprise environments.
* 3\+ years’ experience and proven track record in a Presales Solution Consulting role, ideally within a software/SaaS environment.
* 3\+ years extensive experience presenting to C\-level executives with the ability to communicate influentially.
* Strong understanding of the Financial Planning and Consolidation functional areas as well as Workforce Planning.


**Other Qualifications:**
* Exposure to Planning solutions from Anaplan, Onestream, IBM Planning Analytics/TM1, SAP and Oracle would be an advantage
* Knowledge of Generative and Agentic AI as applied to the Finance domain and experience in positioning embedded or built\-on\-AI solutions to business and technology stakeholders
* Experience engaging with medium and large enterprises across various industries such as FSI, Higher Education, Healthcare, Government, Professional Services and Retail.
* Experience in Workforce, Headcount, Sales and Operational Planning will be desirable.
* You are an exceptional, dynamic presenter with strong communication and influencing skills, specifically to a C\-level Finance leadership audience
* You possess credibility and passion for presentations and product demonstrations around FP\&A technology solutions
* You thrive under pressure and can manage multiple, simultaneous engagements with different prospects
* You are a "continuous learner" who is passionate about innovation and creative problem\-solving.
* Applicants must have willingness to travel up to 50% of the time to engage with customers and partners in the field.
* You are adaptable and excited to work in a high growth, evolving organization.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

f2393ab9.title: Cloud Solution Architect - Cloud & AI
f2393ab9.description:
**Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Cloud Solution Architect to serve as a trusted advisor and technical leader for Microsoft's strategic Retail \& Consumer Goods customers.
   

  

 As a Cloud Solution Architect, you will help customers achieve measurable business outcomes through Azure, AI, Security, Data, Business Applications, Modern Work, and Unified solutions. You will proactively identify customer challenges, translate business requirements into scalable cloud solutions, and drive adoption, consumption, usage, and expansion opportunities across the Microsoft platform.
   

  

 This role requires deep technical expertise, strong executive communication skills, customer\-centric leadership, and the ability to lead virtual teams across Microsoft, partner organizations, and customer stakeholders. The Cloud Solution Architect serves as both a customer advocate and a transformation leader, helping organizations modernize their technology estate while accelerating business value realization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Business Impact
   

  

 Proactively identifies and anticipates new cross\-solution opportunities for Consumption, Usage \& Unified expansion (especially Enhanced Solutions) at scale based on business value to customer/partner and clear understanding of the Microsoft value proposition for supported platforms to empower cloud success, foster and strengthen security and resiliency, and drive AI innovation. Strategically consults with, actively listens to, and respectfully challenges customers/partners, building trust to then advocate for alternative architectures/solutions/approaches that shape and/or enhance customer requirements. Identifies, anticipates, and evaluates industry trends (e.g., customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry), gathers customer/partner insights (e.g., feedback around technical preferences, environments, business needs, competitive landscape), and maps both existing and novel architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business outcomes. Proactively anticipates and captures opportunities in appropriate systems, processes, and tools, working collaboratively across the organization to execute on opportunities aligned with Microsoft's Customer Engagement Model.
   

  

 Anticipates, identifies, escalates, and mitigates blockers using appropriate tools and processes to accelerate solution deployment, value realization and usage/consumption for complex customers/scenarios. Proactively applies broad business, technical, industry, and/or enterprise knowledge to architecture or support projects to meet business and information technology (IT) requirements and resolve identified constraints.
   

  

 Operates according to required operational excellence and proven practice standards throughout all sales stages/activities/tools of record (e.g., pipeline updates, time tracking). Orchestrates and collaborates across Microsoft and customer/partner teams through on\-strategy delivery to achieve customer/partner objectives and increase customer/partner satisfaction. Proactively anticipates and manages business and technical risks, adapts methodology and applies governance principles to identify, communicate, and minimize business and technical risks. Executes work in compliance with industry and Microsoft guidelines and procedures. Continuously prioritizes among competing demands in their work and identifies where impact occurs with customers, ensuring alignment with business priorities and goals.
   

  

 Delivers solutions in line with company methodologies (e.g., product offerings such as value\-based deliverables \[VBDs], advice, training, technical validation), ensuring proven practices and patterns are followed to prepare complex customers for operational readiness and achievement of their business goals and targets. Leveraging knowledge of change management proven practices and/or involving the change management team, proactively helps the customer deploy for long\-term organizational adoption to increase customer satisfaction and drive consumption/usage. Guides complex customers/partners towards a well\-architected (e.g., secure, resilient, artificial intelligence \[AI]\-enabled), and cost\- and performance\-optimized solution to increase retention and expansion opportunities. Articulates the value of Unified and supports sellers, partnering with account teams to build consumption plans aligned with appropriate services. Provides feedback to Unified Delivery Team on VBDs to refine and further develop content.
   

  

 Customer Centricity
   

  

 Proactively identifies and/or translates customer/partner problems into industry solutions aligned with Microsoft product and platform strategy, creates or improves an existing business model, and explains why and/or how they meet customer/partner outcomes and return on investment (ROI) goals (e.g., via proof of concept, minimally viable product \[MVP], rapid prototype) relative to competitive offerings. Proactively helps the customer/partner accelerate their adoption and use of Microsoft product/platform strategy\-aligned (cross\-solution area) solutions. Builds relationships with, and provides direction to technical decision makers (TDMs) up to the C\-suite level, and builds the bridge between TDMs and business decision makers (BDMs). Leads and elevates interactions as needed with customers/partners' Chief Information Office (CIO), Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), and other C\-level (CXO) roles to bridge understanding of security, compliance, operational and risk requirements across BDMs, TDMs, CIO and CISO teams, appropriately engaging additional subject matter experts when deeper expertise is required.
   

  

 Proactively acts as the voice of the customer/partner, sharing ideas, feedback, insights, success stories and strategic/technical input with Engineering teams, Product Offerings teams and internal communities leveraging relevant insights from feedback tools and systems. Identifies and aggregates patterns of feedback across customers/partners/territories/industries, and leverages them with relevant industry perspective to develop strategic and actionable insights. Presents business cases to program managers to advocate for and influence product roadmaps, decision making, and bug fix prioritization, and own and drive initiatives as appropriate.
   

  

 Drives self and guides other team members to focus on customer/partner experience through efficient delivery and ensuring a seamless and connected customer experience. Drives the realization of customer/partner conditions of success by leveraging an understanding of customer goals. Anticipates, addresses, and leads customer confidence calls to resolve customer/partner dissatisfaction and unmet needs, and creates and executes strategies to improve customer experience, value realization, and acceleration of transformation.
   

  

 Partner Specialization
   

  

 Identifies and directs attention to multiple, strategic opportunities (e.g., launch deals) that align with revenue goals, and orchestrates growth of solution utilization pipeline with partners. Leads assistance with partner and sales teams to bring clarity to specific, complex opportunities through proof of concept and technical pre\-sales support.
   

  

 Understands and anticipates solution area\-specific market opportunities (e.g., competitor insights) and proactively leads initiatives to address them by supporting, assembling, and leading a v\-team. Influences, challenges, and supports partners in developing scalable offerings, practices, products, and solutions, and investing and adopting new technologies at scale of the customer. May maintain relationships with non\-technical senior stakeholders (e.g., sales) within the partner to understand their business model. Maintains active visibility in solution area\-specific communities both to build credibility in internal/partner work and information sharing (e.g., technical updates, public facing roadmap) and to influence partners. Collaborates with internal stakeholders (e.g., engineering, sales) to provide field\-based insights related to products/solutions related to functioning, pricing, implementation, and other areas.
   

  

 Technical Leadership
   

  

 Leverages market insights and demand signals to assist leadership in identifying relevant areas in which to drive up\-skilling and/or accreditations based on demand. Role models technical readiness, both depth\-aligned to solution area priorities and breadth\-aligned to Customer Success Unit (CSU)/corporate initiatives (e.g., security, resilience, AI), and influences team to drive their own technical readiness. Acts as a mentor, leading readiness and upskilling activities in the team/organization by educating colleagues on technical and non\-technical concepts and sharing proven practices.
   

  

 Leads, mentors, and may assemble virtual teams around technologies and customer/partner challenges, sharing ideas, insights, and strategic, technical input with technical teams, internal communities across the field, and the larger teams across Microsoft using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and their context in the competitive landscape. Demonstrates deep industry knowledge and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions by leading presentations and engagements with external and internal audiences (e.g., Tech Connect, Build, Ignite) Contributes to and collaborates on intellectual property and proactively identifies patterns where no IP exists (e.g., Copilot and AI scenarios) to help build scalable and repeatable models. Participates in and leads external technical and non\-technical community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, webcasts, blogs, hackathons) that elevate the Microsoft brand and shares learnings across internal teams.
   

  

 Proactively identifies and anticipates gaps through delivery, communicates those gaps to and influences relevant team members and internal/external stakeholders, and connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas that drive changes and improvements to products, intellectual property (IP) (both existing and new), technologies, and/or processes/practices that enable solutions to scale across customers. Develops and contributes to modifications of Microsoft's structured frameworks and methodologies. Proactively provides thought leadership and innovation to customers/partners and internal communities at the worldwide level.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* 12\+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting.
* 10\+ years experience working in a customer\-facing role (e.g., internal and/or external).
* 8\+ years experience leading technical projects.
* Expereince in Azure, AI, Security, Data, Business Applications, Modern Work, and Unified solutions. Deep technical expertise, strong executive communication skills, customer\-centric leadership
* Technical Certification in Cloud (e.g., Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google, security certifications).


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
 **requesting accommodations.**

bbf38da5.title: AI Solutions Architect / FDE
bbf38da5.description:
**About the role** 




  





 D2R AI Labs is looking for a hands\-on Senior AI Solutions Architect / Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) with 8\-12 years of experience to design, build, deploy and scale enterprise AI solutions.
 



  





 Most GenAI projects don't fail at the model. They fail in the gap between a demo and a client's production environment. This role exists to close that gap \- combining AI engineering, solution architecture, enterprise integration and direct customer ownership, from business discovery and architecture through production deployment and optimisation.
 



  





 This is customer\-facing ownership, not internal development or architecture documentation alone.
 



  





 Full job description: https://docs.google.com/document/d/18KoIX0NCNOw3spiMtwalcU25hDnV7Ikj/preview
 



  





**DETAILS** 




 • Experience: 8\-12 years
 



 • Compensation: INR 30\-50 LPA, based on experience, technical depth, certifications and customer\-facing capability
 



 • Location: Flexible \- Remote, Hybrid or in\-office (Chennai), based on what works for you
 



 • Engagement: Full\-time, Contract or C2H
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL DO** 




  





 AI architecture and solution design
 



 • Design scalable, secure, production\-ready AI/ML and Generative AI architectures.
 



 • Architect solutions using LLMs/SLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, AI agents, embeddings, vector databases and retrieval systems.
 



 • Translate business requirements into technical architectures, technology choices and implementation roadmaps.
 



 • Balance performance, latency, scalability, security and cost when selecting models and architectures.
 



  





**Customer\-facing / FDE ownership** 




 • Work directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders to identify high\-value AI opportunities.
 



 • Own delivery from discovery and POC through production deployment, adoption and optimisation.
 



 • Lead architecture workshops, technical discussions, solution demos and customer presentations.
 



 • Bridge customer requirements with engineering and product teams, and rapidly validate solutions in real\-world environments.
 



  





**Hands\-on AI engineering** 




 • Build production\-grade AI applications using Python and modern AI/ML frameworks.
 



 • Develop RAG pipelines covering ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexing, retrieval, reranking, context management and evaluation.
 



 • Build and orchestrate AI agents and workflows using LangChain, LangGraph or equivalent frameworks.
 



 • Work with LLM/SLM APIs, open\-source models, fine\-tuning, inference optimisation and model evaluation.
 



 • Develop APIs, backend services and scalable data pipelines for enterprise AI applications.
 



  





**Enterprise deployment and integration** 




 • Integrate AI solutions with ERP, CRM, ITSM/ticketing systems, databases, business applications and third\-party APIs.
 



 • Deploy using Docker, Kubernetes and major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP).
 



 • Work with GPU infrastructure, model serving, inference optimisation, scalability, latency and cost optimisation.
 



 • Implement AI observability, monitoring, evaluation and production performance measurement.
 



  





**Technical leadership** 




 • Drive architecture decisions, engineering standards, reusable patterns and AI development frameworks.
 



 • Mentor engineers and provide technical direction across AI and software engineering initiatives.
 



 • Create reusable AI playbooks, accelerators, frameworks and best practices.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL BRING (MUST\-HAVE)** 




 • 8\-12 years of overall software/technology experience, with significant AI/ML and/or enterprise architecture experience.
 



 • Strong customer\-facing technical delivery and enterprise stakeholder management \- proven ability to independently lead discovery sessions and technical conversations with senior business stakeholders.
 



 • Production experience with Generative AI, RAG, LLMs/SLMs, embeddings, retrieval systems and/or Agentic AI.
 



 • Strong hands\-on Python development.
 



 • LangChain and/or LangGraph experience.
 



 • Strong software architecture and AI system design capabilities.
 



 • Experience taking AI solutions from POC/prototype to production.
 



 • Cloud deployment plus Docker/Kubernetes experience.
 



 • Experience integrating with at least one major enterprise system: ERP, CRM, ITSM/ticketing, database or business API.
 



  





**NICE TO HAVE** 




 • Palantir Foundry certification (Application Developer / Data Engineer track \- AIP, Ontology) and hands\-on Foundry/AIP experience.
 



 • GPU optimisation and large\-scale model inference.
 



 • AI evaluation frameworks and production observability.
 



 • Fine\-tuning and preference optimisation (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, distillation, DPO, GRPO).
 



 • Experience building reusable AI platforms, accelerators or internal frameworks.
 



 • Domain experience in Banking \& Finance (preferred) or Energy \& Utilities.
 



 • Strong executive\-level communication and presentation skills.
 



  





**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE** 




  





 Someone who can walk into a customer environment, understand the business problem, design the AI solution, build and integrate it, take it to production, and keep improving its performance and business impact.
 



  





**You'll demonstrate:** 




 • Clear, end\-to\-end ownership: business problem to architecture to prototype to production.
 



 • Strong coding ability alongside architecture and system\-design skills.
 



 • The ability to make, explain and defend technical architecture decisions.
 



 • Proven stakeholder management \- comfortable independently driving discovery sessions with senior business stakeholders, not just engineering teams.
 



 • A track record of operating AI systems in production with measurable business impact.

3c284d47.title: Software Architect - Platform Services
3c284d47.description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
   

  

 We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a Software Architect (Platform Services) to play a key role in shaping the software architecture of our remote access, control, and support solutions. In this highly collaborative role, you will work closely with cross\-functional teams to design and evolve our software architecture using the latest technologies and best practices. This is an exciting opportunity to drive innovation, make a tangible impact, and contribute to a culture that values engineering excellence, agility, and teamwork.
   

  

* Conceptualize and design platform\-independent, scalable, secure, reliable and high\-performing cloud / SaaS solutions
* Develop guidelines and best practices around architecture which will be relevant for the whole organization
* Contribute to solution designs incorporating AI capabilities, intelligent services, and automation, with an understanding of how AI frameworks can be effectively integrated into software architectures to increase business value.
* Create and maintain comprehensive and accurate documentation of architectural designs, processes, decisions and best practices
* Provide technical leadership, coaching, guidance and support our platform development teams when it comes to any architectural topic
* Conduct technical assessments and proof of concepts, and evaluate design and implementation approaches
* Keep up to date with the latest technological trends and advances in software architecture, cloud computing and related areas and initiate improvements based on them


**Requirements**
* University or college degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Software Engineering, or any related subject
* 9\+ years of professional experience in the field of object\-oriented software development using C\+\+ or .NET (C\# in particular) combined with extensive knowledge around SQL and NoSQL databases such as MS SQL, Cassandra or Scylla
* Proficient knowledge and experience in the following areas: architectural and coding design patterns; distributed, high\-available and scalable systems; service\-oriented architecture (i.e. microservices) and containerization (e.g. Kubernetes)
* Familiarity with cloud management platforms and infrastructure automation tools are a plus
* Familiarity with integrating or leveraging AI services or frameworks in software architectures is a plus.
* Experience in deploying and managing applications in Azure, AWS or Google Cloud are a plus
* Structured and analytical way of thinking and working, being a team player, as well as motivated to learn new things
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to tackle technical challenges creatively and efficiently
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to clearly convey technical solutions
* Fluency in English is mandatory, further languages such as German are a plus


 TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C\-A\-R\-E and understand that our diverse, values\-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

dcce3484.title: Developer Architect / Technical Lead
dcce3484.description:
**Job Purpose** 




 To architect, build, and own Vyoma’s proprietary cloud stack and platform IP, enabling the launch and scale of enterprisegrade cloud services. The role provides hands\-on technical leadership and architectural governance across the full lifecycle—from core cloud platform components to supporting applications and integrations. The incumbent will define cloud\-native architecture, API and integration frameworks, and extensibility models, and lead engineering teams in building a scalable, secure, and compliant cloud platform. This role ensures that Vyoma’s cloud stack IP
 



 aligns with product strategy, sovereign cloud requirements, security\-by\-design principles, and enterprise compliance standards, translating strategic intent into market\-ready cloud services.
 



  





**Role Description** 




**Key Skills \& Technical Competencies Key Responsibilities** 




 API \& Integration Architecture:
 



 • Strong expertise in API architecture and design – REST, GraphQL, gRPC
 



 • Deep understanding of Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIP)
 



 • Event\-driven and message\-based architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub)
 



 • API lifecycle management – versioning, throttling, monetization, documentation Cloud\-Native \& Platform Architecture:
 



 • Experience across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments – OpenStack, VMware \& hyperscale
 



 cloud AWS, Azure, GCP
 



 • Microservices, containerization, Kubernetes, service mesh
 



 • High availability, resiliency, scalability, and DR architectures
 



 Security, Identity \& Compliance:
 



 • OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, JWT
 



 • API Gateway, WAF, Zero Trust concepts
 



 • Secure SDLC, secrets management, regulatory compliance
 



 Automation, DevOps \& Orchestration:

 • DevOps and DevSecOps practices
 



 • Observability – logging, monitoring, distributed tracing
 



 Architecture Governance \& Design Leadership:
 



 • Architecture documentation (HLD, LLD, C4, ADRs)
 



 • Architect and build Vyoma’s proprietary IP\-led cloud platform and core services.
 



 • Lead end\-to\-end product engineering, translating roadmap into scalable, cloud\-native solutions.
 



 • Define and govern API, integration, and extensibility architecture.
 



 • Ensure platform security, reliability, compliance, and performance by design.
 



 • Drive cloud\-native engineering, automation, and
 



 DevOps practices.
 



 • Provide hands\-on technical leadership and
 



 architecture governance across teams.
 



 • Collaborate with product, security, pre\-sales, and delivery to enable successful cloud service launches.
 



 • Reference architectures and reusable design patterns
 



 • Performance tuning and capacity planning
 



  





**Experience \& Educational Requirements** 




**Qualifications and Experience** 




 EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS: (degree, training, or certification required)
 



 BE/B\-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics \& Communication
 



 RELEVANT EXPERIENCE: (no. of years of technical, functional, and/or leadership experience or specific exposure required)
 



 • 15\+ years of experience in enterprise application development, system design, and architecture, with a strong focus on API\-first and integration\-led platforms.
 



 • Proven experience leading end\-to\-end architecture for large\-scale, business\-critical systems across on\-prem, private cloud, and public cloud environments.
 



 • Extensive hands\-on experience designing and governing REST, GraphQL, and gRPC\-based APIs for internal and external consumers at enterprise scale.
 



 • Strong background in defining and implementing enterprise integration patterns, including synchronous, asynchronous, and event\-driven architectures.
 



 • Demonstrated expertise in designing cloud\-native microservices architectures, ensuring scalability, fault tolerance, and high availability.
 



 • Hands\-on experience working across OpenStack, VMware, AWS, Azure, and GCP, including hybrid and multicloud deployment models.
 



 • Deep experience in API security and identity standards, including OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and secure API Gateway implementations.
 



 • Proven track record of embedding security\-by\-design, compliance, and governance into architecture and development lifecycles.
 



 • Strong experience with automation, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code, enabling faster, reliable, and repeatable deployments.
 



 • Expertise in defining architecture standards, reference architectures, and reusable frameworks across engineering teams.
 



 • Experience leading architecture reviews, design forums, and technical governance boards.
 



 • Strong mentoring experience, guiding senior developers, tech leads, and architects on design, coding standards, and best practices.
 



 • Ability to translate business and non\-functional requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions.

bfc60da1.title: AI Agile Delivery Lead (Senior TPM + Scrum Master)
bfc60da1.description:
**Job Description**
 AI Agile Delivery Lead (Senior TPM \+ Scrum Master)
   

  

**Location:** 
 Manyata Tech Park, Bangalore
   

  

**Company:** 
 Black Box
   

  

**Company Overview**
 Black Box is a global leader in digital infrastructure solutions, delivering network and system integration, managed services, and technology products to enterprises worldwide. As part of our strategic transformation, Black Box is expanding its AI Center of Excellence (CoE) to deliver enterprise\-grade AI solutions across multiple business domains.
   

  

 The AI CoE focuses on building scalable, secure, and production\-ready AI systems, establishing best practices for enterprise AI adoption, and integrating AI capabilities into core business platforms.
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 As an
 **Agile Delivery Lead (Senior TPM \+ Scrum Master hybrid)** 
 in the AI Center of Excellence (CoE), you will run the
 **delivery operating system** 
 for multiple AI squads, ensuring predictable execution, strong Agile discipline, and high accountability across cross\-functional stakeholders.
   

  

 This role is accountable for end\-to\-end Agile execution using
 **Azure DevOps (Boards)** 
 , including sprint ceremonies, backlog and sprint hygiene, capacity planning and bottleneck visibility, dependency and risk management (RAID), and driving closure of action items across engineering, platform teams (ServiceNow, SAP, Salesforce, M365/SharePoint), cybersecurity, and leadership stakeholders.
   

  

 Core Outcomes (Non\-Negotiable)
   

  

* Run sprint planning, daily standups, sprint demos, and retrospectives for multiple squads.
* Enforce Azure DevOps Boards hygiene: quality work items, estimates, dependencies, sprint updates, WIP discipline, and clear sprint scope boundaries.
* Provide clear capacity and bottleneck visibility: are squads loaded, blocked, or underutilized?
* Maintain a single source of truth RAID \+ action tracker, with weekly closure and transparent ownership across teams and leadership.
* Produce weekly exec\-ready status reporting (progress, risks, dependencies, decisions required, next milestones).


 Key Responsibilities Agile Delivery \& Scrum Operations
   

  

* Own Agile delivery cadence across squads: sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement (with PM/PO), sprint demos, and retrospectives.
* Enforce disciplined sprint execution: clear sprint goals, WIP limits, acceptance criteria, and Definition of Done.
* Ensure work items are sprint\-ready with estimates, dependency links, scope clarity, and test/release criteria.
* Improve delivery predictability through metrics and continuous improvement (spillover reduction, blocker aging, cycle time improvement).


 Azure DevOps (Boards) Delivery Hygiene
   

  

* Maintain clean Backlogs / Boards / Sprints in Azure DevOps: work item quality, state transitions, iteration paths, area paths, tagging conventions, and parent/child linking.
* Ensure dependency tracking is explicit using work item links, queries, and dependency views.
* Establish and enforce consistent standards: work item templates, Definition of Ready/Done gates, and sprint reporting cadence.


 Technical Program Management \& Cross\-Functional Delivery
   

  

* Own execution across multiple AI initiatives: milestones, dependencies, integration readiness, and release planning.
* Drive coordination across enterprise stakeholders: ServiceNow, SAP, Salesforce, M365/SharePoint, Security, DevOps/Infra, and business owners.
* Lead risk and dependency management (RAID) and proactively escalate decision blockers with crisp options and recommendations.
* Coordinate go\-live readiness: environment availability, access readiness, security approvals, QA/UAT readiness, and change management steps.


 Visibility, Reporting \& Executive Communication
   

  

* Build and maintain dashboards/queries in Azure DevOps for transparency: velocity, burn\-down/burn\-up, blocker aging, dependency burn\-down, and sprint health.
* Publish weekly status updates and leadership\-ready summaries (milestones achieved, next priorities, risks, and asks).
* Ensure decision logs and meeting outcomes are captured with owners and due dates; follow through to closure.


 Release Readiness \& Delivery Governance
   

  

* Own release checklists and execution readiness: testing plans, approvals, operational readiness, and rollback considerations.
* Coordinate post\-release stabilization and lessons learned; convert findings into actionable process improvements.


 Required Skills
   

  

* 7\+ years’ experience in Technical Program Management / Delivery Management, including Scrum Master responsibilities.
* Strong, practical expertise in Agile/Scrum delivery for software teams with cross\-team dependencies.
* Deep hands\-on experience with Azure DevOps (Boards)—backlogs, sprints, queries, dashboards, reporting, and hygiene enforcement.
* Proven ability to drive accountability and action closure across engineering, platform teams, and leadership.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and conflict\-resolution skills; comfortable operating in ambiguity and shifting priorities.


 Preferred Skills
   

  

* Experience delivering AI/ML or LLM\-enabled products (RAG, copilots, workflow automation, enterprise assistants).
* Experience with enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow, SAP, Salesforce, M365/SharePoint, and Azure services.
* Familiarity with security/compliance workflows (RBAC, private endpoints, managed identities, approvals).
* Certifications: CSM/PSM, SAFe, PMP (any are a plus).


 About Black Box
   

  

 Black Box is a leading technology solutions provider focused on accelerating customer success through innovation, ownership, transparency, and collaboration. With over 2,500 team members across 24 countries, Black Box delivers high\-value solutions globally by designing, integrating, and managing complex technology environments for enterprises.

b0bdbd1e.title: Zoho Solution Consultant
b0bdbd1e.description:
**Zoho Solution Consultant** 




**Location:** 
 Remote
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience Required:** 
 2\+ years (mandatory) 
 



**Compensation:** 
 5 LPA \+ Bonus
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We're looking for a Zoho Solution Consultant to join our team at
 **Orpheus Technologies** 
 , a Zoho partner organization that helps businesses design, implement, and adopt Zoho's suite of applications. In this role, you'll work directly with prospective and existing clients to understand their operational challenges and translate them into working Zoho\-based solutions — spanning CRM, Books, Projects, Desk, Creator, Analytics, People, Cliq, and other apps in the Zoho ecosystem depending on client needs.
 



**Success in this role looks like:** 
 clients leaving discovery calls and demos with confidence that Zoho can solve their specific problem, solution designs that require minimal rework during implementation, and a growing reputation (internally and with clients) as the go\-to person for "can Zoho do this?" questions. This role sits at the intersection of our sales and implementation teams — you'll support the sales cycle with technical credibility, then help ensure what's promised during the demo is what actually gets delivered.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Gather and document client business requirements across departments (sales, finance, operations, support, HR) to identify how Zoho applications can address their needs
* Design end\-to\-end solution architectures that combine multiple Zoho apps (e.g., CRM \+ Books \+ Projects) to fit a client's workflow
* Deliver product demonstrations and proof\-of\-concept walkthroughs tailored to each client's use case
* Partner with the sales team during pre\-sales calls to answer technical and functional questions in real time
* Translate approved solutions into clear configuration and implementation plans for the delivery team
* Stay current on new Zoho product releases, features, and integrations to keep client\-facing recommendations accurate
* Identify opportunities to cross\-sell or upsell additional Zoho applications based on a client's evolving needs
* Create and maintain reusable demo environments, solution templates, and documentation for common client scenarios
* Troubleshoot functional gaps between client expectations and Zoho's out\-of\-the\-box capabilities, proposing custom workarounds (Deluge scripts, Zoho Creator apps, third\-party integrations) where needed



  





**Qualifications** 




  





**Experience** 



* Minimum 2 years of hands\-on experience working with Zoho applications in a consulting, implementation, or solutions role (mandatory)
* Demonstrated working knowledge across most of the Zoho suite (CRM, Books, Desk, Projects, Creator, Analytics, People, Cliq, Campaigns, or similar) — this is not a single\-product role
* Prior experience in a client\-facing or pre\-sales capacity preferred.



  





**Skills** 



* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong requirements\-gathering and solution\-design skills
* Comfort presenting live demos to clients and handling on\-the\-spot questions
* Basic familiarity with Deluge scripting or Zoho Creator (a plus, not mandatory)



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)



  





**Certifications** 



* Zoho certifications (CRM, Books, or other suite\-specific) are a plus but not required



  





**Our Hiring Process** 



1. **Application review** 
 — we review your resume and profile (\[typical turnaround, e.g., within 5 business days])
2. **Initial screening call** 
 (\[15–30 min]) — with our recruiter, to discuss your background and the role
3. **Solutioning exercise / case discussion** 
 — a practical conversation or short exercise on how you'd approach a sample client scenario using Zoho apps
4. **Interview with hiring manager** 
 — deeper discussion on experience, technical depth, and team fit
5. **Offer \& background check**



 We aim to keep candidates informed at each stage and will let you know if you're not moving forward.

**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 You will take on the role of IT SAP FICO Solution Architect, supporting and guiding initiatives across the global financial systems landscape by designing robust and scalable SAP FI/CO solutions that build on existing platforms. Your expertise in accounting and SAP FI/CO processes enables you to translate complex business requirements into practical, high\-quality concepts that strengthen global financial processes.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with project teams, business stakeholders, and IT colleagues to review functional designs, validate data flows, and ensure new solutions integrate seamlessly with SAP ECC, S/4HANA, consolidation tools, and treasury systems. A significant part of your day will be spent supporting initiatives across countries and ERP environments, harmonizing processes, and ensuring local requirements align with global standards. You will identify improvement opportunities, uncover automation potential, and assess where AI\-driven enhancements can add value while maintaining operational stability.
   

  

 You will also contribute to strengthening in\-house capabilities by coaching colleagues, sharing best practices, and enabling teams to deliver high\-value use cases. Through your work, you will help mature the SAP and finance community while shaping high\-impact solutions within a global environment.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Drive end\-to\-end SAP FI data\-driven reporting initiatives from preparation and conception through realization and Go Live, covering both transactional and consolidated data.
* Lead multiple projects and operational tasks in parallel, ensuring smooth execution across a complex system landscape.
* Perform deep SAP FI data analysis to validate data quality, strengthen configurations, and support informed decision\-making.
* Facilitate workshops and stakeholder meetings, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Build and expand in\-house expertise across SAP ERP, treasury, and consolidation systems to enable delivery of high\-value use cases.
* Champion global process harmonization by aligning country\-specific and ERP\-specific processes within a unified architecture that drives consistency and scalability.
* Identify redundancies and evaluate opportunities for AI\-driven automation, presenting strategic proposals to enhance efficiency and accelerate innovation.
* Bring forward creative ideas and practical solutions to complex challenges, fostering continuous improvement.
* Stay adaptable and resilient in the face of shifting priorities, ambiguity, and tight deadlines while continuously developing professional capabilities.


**What You Bring**
* A university degree in Finance, Informatics, Computer Science, or a related field; qualifications such as ACCA, CA, CIMA, CMA, or MBA\-Finance are preferred.
* More than five years of experience in a consulting environment or within the IT organization of a global company or comparable enterprise delivering SAP\-focused implementation and support services.
* Strong understanding of financial business processes and extensive hands\-on expertise in SAP FI configuration.
* Solid experience integrating SAP FI and SAP CO with other SAP modules to ensure seamless end\-to\-end process flows.
* Experience working with virtual, globally distributed teams in international project environments.
* Proven project\-leading experience in S/4HANA implementation initiatives.
* High customer orientation, strong service mindset, and the business acumen to translate requirements into effective solutions.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills that support collaboration and stakeholder alignment.
* Strong writing, mentoring, decision\-making, and facilitation capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to coach and guide colleagues to ensure high\-quality project outcomes and consulting services.

With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

**Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Manager to join the Data Governance (DG) Platform Team, responsible for leading the technical implementation, expansion, and run operations of PepsiCo’s global data privacy platform, Securiti.ai. This role is accountable for delivering scalable privacy tooling capabilities across the enterprise, ensuring the platform is configured, integrated, and operationalized to meet evolving business and regulatory needs.
   

  

 This position will partner closely with the Data Governance Policy as well as Legal Privacy teams to understand and define data privacy requirements and implement through platform\-based capabilities, workflows, and automations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end technical implementation and enhancement roadmap for Securiti.ai, partnering with key stakeholders across Data Governance, Data Stewardship, Legal Privacy, and Data Product Management.
* Translate privacy process requirements into platform configurations, workflows, rules, automation, and integrations (APIs, connectors, etc.).
* Lead delivery of core privacy workflows (e.g., consent, PIAs, ROPA, DSR) including design, build, test, release, and post\-production stabilization.
* Drive enterprise integrations between Securiti.ai and PepsiCo applications to enable automation and scaled data discovery/fulfillment.
* Own technical delivery management: project execution, backlog grooming, dependency tracking, risk management, release planning, and go\-live readiness.
* Partner with InfoSec/IT stakeholders to ensure implementations align with security, architecture, and operational standards (e.g., access controls, logging, SDLC, environments).
* Establish and maintain platform run excellence: monitoring, incident triage, root cause analysis, defect remediation, SLA adherence, and continuous improvement.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation (solution designs, configuration baselines, integration specs, runbooks, and release notes) and contribute to platform adoption enablement.
* People Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
* Manage a team of FTE and contract resources, including onboarding, work planning, coaching, and delivery accountability.
* Serve as a key technical point of contact for senior stakeholders, providing clear status reporting (risks/issues, progress updates, escalations, etc.)
* Coordinate effectively across DG Platform, DG Capability teams, Legal Privacy, Compliance, IT/InfoSec, Data Product teams, and vendor partners to drive timely delivery.


**Qualifications**
 Qualifications \& Requirements
   

  

* 10\+ years of overall experience
* Experience in data privacy related role in complex global organization.
* Hands\-on Securiti.ai experience is required, including configuration and delivery of at least several core modules (Consent mgt, PIAs, ROPA, DSR, etc.).
* Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise implementations involving workflow automation, systems integrations, and production operations.
* Working knowledge of major privacy regulations and concepts (e.g., GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) and ability to translate obligations into technical requirements and controls.
* Strong technical fluency with APIs/integrations, environments, testing, and operational readiness; ability to work effectively with engineers and architects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate clearly with both technical teams and non\-technical senior stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).


**Preferred Skills**
* Applied scripting or programming capability (e.g., SQL, JavaScript) and comfort working with APIs and automation.
* Experience with consent management implementations across web/mobile and enterprise tagging/consent patterns.

bdce3d9f.description:
**What You’ll Do**
 The Program Manager will lead complex, cross\-functional strategic initiatives within ES\-A, with primary responsibility for driving the successful deployment of enterprise digital transformation programs, including the Enovia platform upgrade. This role requires strong program leadership, executive stakeholder management, and the ability to align business, engineering, and IT organizations to achieve program objectives.
   

  

 The successful candidate will operate at both strategic and operational levels, partnering with senior engineering and technology leaders to define deployment roadmaps, manage risks, and ensure successful adoption across multiple business divisions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Program Leadership
   

  

* Direct and manage large\-scale, global ES\-A transformation programs, including the Enovia upgrade initiative.
* Develop and execute comprehensive deployment strategies tailored to the specific needs of multiple business divisions.
* Establish program governance, milestones, success metrics, and reporting mechanisms to ensure effective execution.
* Drive program planning, risk management, issue resolution, and change control activities.


 Stakeholder Management \& Alignment
   

  

* Lead strategic stakeholder engagement across ES\-A Engineering, Information Technology (IT), and Engineering Functional Excellence (EFE) teams.
* Build alignment among diverse functional leaders and business stakeholders to ensure successful program adoption and outcomes.
* Facilitate decision\-making processes and resolve competing business priorities through influence and collaboration.
* Maintain strong communication channels across global teams and leadership levels.


 Executive Communication \& Governance
   

  

* Prepare and deliver executive\-level program reviews, strategic roadmaps, and status updates to Senior Vice Presidents and Engineering leadership teams.
* Provide ongoing visibility to Vice President\-level stakeholders regarding program health, risks, dependencies, and achievement of business objectives.
* Develop concise executive communication materials including dashboards, presentations, and business cases.


 Cross\-Functional Execution
   

  

* Coordinate activities across engineering, IT, operations, and business functions to drive program execution.
* Monitor program performance against schedule, budget, scope, and quality targets.
* Identify and mitigate risks while ensuring timely escalation of critical issues.
* Support change management, training, and user adoption activities associated with enterprise system deployments.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology
* 10\+ years of program or project management experience in a global, matrixed environment.


**Skills**
* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise\-wide digital transformation, PLM, ERP, or systems deployment initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Experience presenting to senior leadership and executive audiences.
* Strong analytical, planning, and risk management capabilities.


**Preferred**
* PMP, PgMP, PROLaunch, or equivalent program management certification.
* Experience with Enovia, PLM systems, or product lifecycle management processes.
* Knowledge of engineering product development and engineering data management processes.
* Experience managing geographically dispersed global teams.
