902ca740.title: Data Architect
902ca740.description:
**About us**

  

At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net\-zero future. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

  

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.

  

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about **our What and our Why** and how we canwork **together**.

**ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India**
------------------------------------

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.

  

ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market\-development activities.

  

The Global Business Center \- Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.

  

ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate, and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community\-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.

  

To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.

**What role you will play in our team**
---------------------------------------

  

The Data Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing the organization’s data architecture to ensure data integrity, scalability, and security. This role involves creating data models, defining data standards, and collaborating with stakeholders to align data strategies with business objectives.

**What you will do**
--------------------

 **Data Architecture Design:**


Develop and maintain enterprise\-level data architecture, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models.

 **Data Integration \& Management:**


Design and implement data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration strategies for structured and unstructured data sources.

 **Governance \& Compliance:**


Establish data governance frameworks, ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.), and maintain data quality standards.

 **Performance Optimization:**


Optimize database performance, storage, and retrieval processes for high availability and scalability.

 **Collaboration:**


Work closely with data engineers, analysts, and business teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

 **Technology Evaluation:**


Assess and recommend tools, platforms, and technologies for data management and analytics.

**About you**
-------------

 **Skills and Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree from a recognized university in Computer/IT other relevant engineering disciplines.
* Minimum 10\+ years of experience with data processing / analytics, and ETL data transformation. Proficient in ingesting data to/from Snowflake, Azure storage account.
* Proficiency in at least one of the following languages: Python, C\#, C\+\+, F\#, Java.
* Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases. Knowledge of SQL query development and optimization.
* Demonstrated experience Snowflake, Qlik Replicate, Fivetran, Azure Data Explorer.
* Cloud azure experience (current/future) used (ADX, ADF, Databricks).
* Expertise with Airflow, Qlik, Fivetran, Azure Data Factory.
* Management of Snowflake through DBT scripting.
* Solid understanding of data strategies, including data management, data curation, and data governance.
* Ability to quickly build relationships and credibility with business customers and agile teams.
* A passion for learning about and experimenting with new technologies.
* Confidence in creating and delivering technical presentations and training.
* Excellent organization and planning skills

 **Preferred Qualifications/ Experience**

  

* Experience with Airtable platform is a plus
* Working knowledge of Azure Databricks
* Working knowledge of various data storage technologies
* Working knowledge of big data tools (e.g., Hadoop, MongoDB, Kafka, HDFS, YARM, etc.)
* Working knowledge of Containers Technologies (OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes)
**Your benefits**
-----------------

  

An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep: our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance and life. We offer you:

  

* Competitive compensation
* Medical plans, maternity leave and benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment benefits
* Retirement benefits
* Global networking \& cross\-functional opportunities
* Annual vacations \& holidays
* Day care assistance program
* Training and development program
* Tuition assistance program
* Workplace flexibility policy
* Relocation program
* Transportation facility

  

Please note benefits may change from time to time without notice, subject to applicable laws. The benefits programs are based on the Company’s eligibility guidelines.

**Stay connected with us**
--------------------------

  

* Learn more about ExxonMobil in India, visit **ExxonMobil India**and **Energy Factor India****.**
* Follow us on**LinkedIn** **and** **Instagram**
* Like us on **Facebook**
* Subscribe our channel at **YouTube**
**EEO Statement**
-----------------

  

ExxonMobil is an Equal Opportunity Employer:

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin or disability status.

**Business solicitation and recruiting scams**
----------------------------------------------

  

ExxonMobil does not use recruiting or placement agencies that charge candidates an advance fee of any kind (e.g., placement fees, immigration processing fees, etc.). Follow the LINK to understand more about recruitment scams in the name of ExxonMobil.

**Functional Skills**
---------------------


Data Visualization
Data Modeling
Applied Software Engineering for Data
Data Architecture \& Strategy
Data Integration
Data Compliance Governance \& Security
Data Management

030f049f.description:
**Technical Program Manager** 




**Location:** 
 Bangalore (Manyata Tech Park)
 



**Experience:** 
 6\+ Years
 



  





**About HiLabs** 




 HiLabs is a fast\-growing healthcare technology company focused on solving large\-scale healthcare data challenges through AI, advanced analytics, and intelligent automation. Our platforms help healthcare organizations improve data quality, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
 



 We are looking for a highly driven
 **Technical Program Manager** 
 to lead complex healthcare technology programs and drive successful client delivery across multiple stakeholders.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys solving complex delivery challenges, and can effectively partner with Engineering, Product, Implementation, and Customer Success teams to deliver exceptional outcomes.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As a Technical Program Manager, you will serve as the primary owner for client delivery, ensuring programs are delivered on time, within scope, and with high customer satisfaction.
 



 You will be responsible for managing program execution, stakeholder communication, delivery governance, risks, dependencies, and cross\-functional coordination from kickoff through go\-live and stabilization.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Program \& Delivery Ownership** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery accountability from program kickoff through go\-live and stabilization.
* Drive execution across Engineering, Product, Data, Implementation, and Client teams.
* Create and manage integrated delivery plans, milestones, timelines, and dependencies.
* Ensure successful delivery of multiple concurrent client programs.



**Client Leadership** 



* Act as the primary client\-facing delivery owner and escalation point.
* Provide transparent communication on progress, risks, dependencies, and key decisions.
* Build strong relationships with business and technical stakeholders.



**Risk \& Dependency Management** 



* Identify and proactively manage delivery risks and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Drive mitigation plans and escalate issues appropriately.
* Ensure timely resolution of delivery blockers.



**Scope \& Change Management** 



* Own scope management and change control processes.
* Partner with Product and Customer Success teams to manage priorities and trade\-offs.
* Ensure alignment between business objectives and delivery commitments.



**Governance \& Reporting** 



* Establish delivery governance frameworks and reporting cadences.
* Track and report KPIs related to delivery health and client satisfaction.
* Prepare weekly program dashboards, executive updates, and status reports.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* 6\+ years of experience managing enterprise technology programs or client\-facing project deliveries.
* 6\+ years of experience working with enterprise clients and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Proven experience leading software delivery programs involving Engineering, Product, QA, and Customer Success teams.
* Strong program governance, stakeholder management, risk management, and communication skills.
* **Bachelor's or Master's degree from a Tier\-1 institution Must.**
* Willingness to relocate to Bangalore and work from the office five days a week.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Healthcare technology or healthcare IT experience.
* PMP, PMI\-ACP, or equivalent certification.
* Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery environments.
* Exposure to SaaS, cloud\-based platforms, data platforms, or AI\-driven products.



  





**Why Join HiLabs?** 



* Work on large\-scale healthcare data, analytics, and AI platforms.
* Partner with high\-performing engineering and product teams.
* Lead impactful programs that improve healthcare outcomes.
* Gain exposure to global clients and enterprise\-scale technology initiatives.
* Be part of a fast\-growing company solving meaningful healthcare challenges through innovation and technology.

A Team Leader, people management and development mindset

e521af01.description:
**Description**
 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

 What You'll Actually Be Doing
   

  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


 You're Our Person If...
   

  

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

f36a8feb.title: Delivery Manager
f36a8feb.description:
Job Summary:
 



 As a Delivery Manager, you make delivery reliable across a portfolio of game studios. You do not build the games. Each studio lead owns their team’s production and their committed dates. Your job is to validate and de\-risk those commitments before they go upward, and to own the cross\-studio seam no single studio can see: risks, dependencies, and blockers across teams.
 



  





 You lead through influence, not direct control. You support studio leads toward autonomy and scale your involvement to how established each one is. You go hands\-on where a lead is still growing and stay light\-touch where they run reliably on their own.
 



  





 The strongest sign of your success is a studio that no longer needs you. You also line\-manage a
 



 team of Delivery Coordinators who keep day\-to\-day coordination running.
 


 Key Responsibilities:
 * Validate \& De\-Risk Commitments: Stress\-test each studio lead’s delivery plan, estimates, and risks before they go upward. You challenge and de\-risk; you do not overwrite. Where a date stays in dispute, you escalate it cleanly rather than override.
* Own the Cross\-Studio Seam: Coordinate and clarify dependencies, risks, and blockers across studios, always respecting each studio lead's ownership of their own team.
* Support Studio Leads Toward Autonomy: Support studio leads as they grow, matched to each studio’s maturity. Work more closely with newer leads and ease off as a studio runs reliably on its own. Think of your role as scaffolding: temporary support that helps a studio stand on its own.
* Lead \& Develop Coordinators: Line\-manage a team of Delivery Coordinators, set consistent coordination standards, and grow their careers. Arbitrate when a studio’s day\-to\-day urgency and your cross\-studio priorities collide, so your coordinators are never caught between two bosses.
* Manage Risk \& Escalation: Decide which risks to absorb and which to escalate. Raise issues early, with clear framing and timing, so the business handles them before they reach senior leadership.
* Be the Single Source of Delivery Truth: Act as the one trusted channel between your studios and the wider business. PMO, governance, and senior leadership read the delivery picture through you and the shared board, not by interrogating individual teams. Keep that picture accurate and current.



 What Success Looks Like (First 3 to 6 Months)
 


* You validate and de\-risk studio commitments before they go upward, so dates hold and disputes escalate cleanly when they arise.
* You reconcile cross\-studio dependencies and resourcing conflicts before they stall a team.
* Your coordinators operate to a consistent standard, and growing studio leads are visibly more autonomous than when you started.
* The Director of Delivery has one trusted source of delivery truth for your portfolio.


 Required Qualifications:
 
 MUST HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
 


* Experience: 5\+ years as a Delivery Manager or delivery lead for cross\-functional teams of 5 to 50 people, ideally across multiple teams at once.
* Delivery Craft: Strong command of the SDLC and Agile delivery: planning and execution, risk management, quality assurance, resource management, performance monitoring, and stakeholder management.
* Influence Without Authority: A proven track record of securing reliable commitments from leaders you do not directly manage, and of holding a portfolio\-level view across competing teams.
* People Leadership: Experience managing and developing coordinators, PMs, or similar. You set standards and grow people, not just track tasks.
* Mindset: A startup mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and ready to build and scale a delivery function from the ground up.

**Purpose of the role** 




  





 Design and build the Investment Division’s data and AI platform on Databricks/Azure, serving as the technical lead for the three\-person AI Lab. Own the platform architecture, integration layer connecting Addepar, Capital IQ, and all data sources to the lakehouse, the serving infrastructure delivering model outputs to dashboards, chat interface, and APIs, and the security and governance framework ensuring regulatory compliance. * 8–12 years of experience in data engineering and platform architecture, with at least 3 years on Databricks or equivalent lakehouse platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow.
* Experience with Azure cloud services: Azure Data Factory, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Key Vault, Azure Active Directory.

165232dd.title: Cloud Application Support Engineer (APAC) - Noida
165232dd.description:
**Our Context**
 NeoXam is a growing international financial software company headquartered in Paris, with a strong and expanding presence across India. Through our combined expertise and transparent approach, we help Buy\-Side and Sell\-Side organizations \- across banking, asset management, and insurance \- navigate the continuous changes shaping the financial industry. Our solutions span the complete financial value chain, from centralized data management to front\- and back\-office software.
   

  

 With 750\+ dedicated staff across 21 offices worldwide \- including Sydney, Melbourne, New York, Boston, Paris, Frankfurt, Luxembourg, Zurich, Geneva, Milan, London, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Singapore, Noida, Chennai, and more \- NeoXam combines global scale with an entrepreneurial, collaborative culture. More than 150 clients across the globe trust NeoXam to run their most critical workflows.
   

  

 As part of our expanding NeoXam as a Service (NXaaS) operating model, we are looking for a motivated and technically strong
 **Technical Support \& Cloud Consultant** 
 to join our Indian team. This is a hands\-on role that blends client\-facing support with cloud infrastructure ownership, making it ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of financial software and modern cloud operations. As we continue to grow our global SaaS footprint, this role will evolve alongside increasing monitoring, observability, and operational responsibilities. NXaaS operates a follow\-the\-sun support model across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas \- this role covers Indian business hours.
   

  

 You will support NeoXam's core product suite, including:
   

  

* NeoXam DataHub – a centralized data management platform purpose\-built for financial institutions, serving as a hub for all data consumed or produced across the enterprise.
* NeoXam IBOR – a uniquely independent and flexible Investment Book of Record, providing asset managers with a single, continuously updated source for positions, valuations, and forecasts across multiple views.
* NeoXam Aro – an intelligent, low\-code reconciliation and data lifecycle platform that transforms fragmented, manual processes into a unified, AI\-powered solution.
* NeoXam Impress – an end\-to\-end solution for client, digital, and regulatory reporting, covering data integration, performance calculations, production workflows, and data visualization.


**Your Missions**
 Serve as the first technical point of contact for NeoXam's global clients, covering Australian business hours within NeoXam's follow\-the\-sun support model and ensuring seamless handoff with APAC and EMEA counterparts.
   

  

* Triage, analyze, and own support tickets end\-to\-end \- from anomaly identification and root cause investigation through to resolution, including software\-level fixes in Java and escalation to R\&D when required.
* Review and respond to monitoring alerts and operational dashboards, identifying and acting on anomalies before they impact clients; monitor and manage cloud resources (primarily AWS) to ensure performance and availability against production SLAs.
* Troubleshoot and enhance cloud\-based deployments; implement patches and configuration fixes; support data migration and cloud onboarding initiatives in collaboration with clients and internal teams.
* Manage technical installations, upgrades, and environment refreshes for client\-facing deployments; maintain internal environment replicas for issue reproduction and testing.
* Collaborate with the Paris R\&D team and global support counterparts to resolve complex issues and contribute to the NXaaS knowledge base.
* Support pre\-sales and implementation teams on technical matters; participate in client calls, project updates, and cross\-team coordination.


**Your Profile**
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

* 5\-8 years of experience in technical support, implementation, or infrastructure roles within financial software or the banking/financial services industry.
* Solid working knowledge of AWS (EC2, RDS, ALB, S3, CloudWatch, VPC, IAM); AWS certification is a plus.
* Proficient in Java application troubleshooting \- log analysis, memory management, thread dumps, and configuration.
* Ability to diagnose and interpret common database performance issues \- including slow queries, missing indexes, lock contention, and execution plan analysis. Experience with Oracle and/or PostgreSQL query tuning is strongly preferred.
* Experience with relational databases \- Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
* Scripting ability (Shell, Python, or equivalent) for automation and diagnostics.
* Familiarity with web application servers (Tomcat, JBoss, or WebSphere) and messaging systems (IBM MQ, Kafka, or equivalent).
* Working knowledge of XML, REST/SOAP web services, and API integrations.
* EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service): Strong understanding of Kubernetes fundamentals and practical experience with Amazon EKS for container orchestration from support perspective.
* Monitoring \& Observability Tools: Hands\-on experience with solutions such as Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch or similar platforms for system monitoring, logging, and performance visualization.
* Familiarity with Git and standard version control workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with Linux/Unix environments and command\-line operations.
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology and ITIL support practices.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to manage client relationships professionally and independently.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and collaborative — comfortable working across time zones with global teams.


**Why NeoXam**
 At NeoXam, we love people who are curious, involved, and self\-driven. We encourage creativity and strive to promote an environment and culture based on personal growth and development. We want you to express your full potential and become a major contributor to our continued growth across India and beyond.

55353992.title: AI, Sr Architect
55353992.description:
**We Are:**


At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self\-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high\-performance silicon chips and intelligent software systems. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.

  

As part of our Generative AI / Agentic AI initiatives, we are building next\-generation intelligent applications powered by LLMs, workflows, tools, memory, and autonomous decisioning. Our team is focused on delivering scalable, production\-grade AI full\-stack solutions that create measurable business impact.

 **You Are:**


You are a hands\-on senior engineering leader with a passion for building production\-grade **agentic AI systems** and **AI full\-stack applications**. You thrive in fast\-paced, collaborative environments and enjoy solving complex problems across orchestration, memory, reasoning, backend systems, and user experience. You bring strong technical depth in modern AI application development, combined with the leadership skills to guide teams, mentor engineers, and drive delivery excellence.


You are excited by the challenge of developing workflow\-driven agentic systems using frameworks such as **ADK, NAT, and other agent orchestration frameworks**, and you understand how to combine LLMs, tools, memory, retrieval, and guardrails into reliable applications. You balance innovation with engineering rigor and are committed to building secure, scalable, and responsible AI solutions.

 **What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Design, build, and deploy **agentic AI applications** and **AI full\-stack solutions** using frameworks such as **ADK, NAT, Langchain, CrewAI and similar agent platforms**.
* Develop intelligent workflows for planning, reasoning, task decomposition, tool execution, reflection, and multi\-step orchestration.
* Implement and optimize **memory architectures**, including:
	+ **Semantic memory**
	+ **Procedural memory**
	+ **Episodic memory**
	+ **Working/session memory**
	+ Long\-term memory consolidation and retrieval patterns
* Conduct LLM evaluations for agentic applications, factoring in cost and performance considerations to optimize solutions.
* Build integrations with enterprise tools, APIs, knowledge bases, databases, search systems, and external services using **tool calling**, **function calling**, and **MCP/equivalent connector patterns** where applicable.
* Develop backend services, orchestration layers, APIs, and supporting full\-stack components for AI applications, including human\-in\-the\-loop experiences and operational dashboards.
* Implement **RAG pipelines**, vector search, knowledge retrieval, prompt orchestration, and contextual grounding for agents.
* Design robust agent state management, persistence, retry, fallback, and recovery mechanisms for workflow\-driven systems.
* Establish evaluation frameworks for agent quality, memory relevance, tool\-use success, trajectory quality, hallucination reduction, latency, cost, and safety.
* Build observability and monitoring for agentic systems, including tracing, logging, prompt/version tracking, workflow telemetry, and incident analysis.
* Apply guardrails, policy controls, validation layers, and secure design practices to ensure safe and responsible AI behavior.
* Mentor engineers, drive design reviews, establish best practices, and contribute to engineering standards for agentic application development.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, researchers, platform teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.

 **The Impact You Will Have:**

* Accelerate Synopsys’ adoption of **agentic AI** through scalable, workflow\-driven applications.
* Enable delivery of robust AI systems that combine LLMs, tools, memory, and orchestration to solve high\-value business problems.
* Improve engineering productivity and business efficiency through reusable agentic patterns, platform components, and best practices.
* Raise the technical maturity of the team through mentorship, code quality, architecture guidance, and knowledge sharing.
* Help establish Synopsys as a leader in responsible, enterprise\-grade AI application development.

 **What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, or related field. PhD is a plus.
* **Minimum 15\+ years of software engineering experience**, including strong hands\-on experience building and shipping production systems.
* Proven experience delivering **AI/ML, GenAI, or agentic AI applications** in production environments.
* Strong proficiency in **Python** and at least one of **JavaScript, Java, C\+\+, or Go**.
* Experience with **ADK, NAT, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or similar agentic development frameworks**.
* Strong understanding of:
	+ LLM application design
	+ Workflow orchestration
	+ Prompt engineering
	+ Tool/function calling
	+ RAG architectures
	+ Memory systems for agents
	+ Multi\-agent collaboration patterns
* Experience with **vector databases**, search systems, embeddings, and knowledge retrieval pipelines.
* Experience building **AI full\-stack applications**, including backend APIs/microservices and frontend or user\-facing AI experiences.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as **AWS, GCP, or Azure**, and container/orchestration technologies such as **Docker and Kubernetes**.
* Experience with **CI/CD**, Git\-based development, testing, and Agile/Scrum practices.
* Strong understanding of observability, evaluation, guardrails, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience in semiconductor, EDA, developer productivity, or enterprise software domains is a plus.

 **Who You Are:**

* A strong systems thinker and pragmatic problem solver.
* A hands\-on technical leader who can move between architecture and implementation.

5af57214.title: Pre Sales Associate
5af57214.description:
We are looking for a **Presales Associate** who enjoys speaking to people, understands how to build relationships over the phone, and wants to eventually grow into a full\-fledged sales role.

This is not a traditional real estate telecalling role where the objective is simply to generate a site visit.

At **D’Quor Spaces Co.**, our customers are evaluating second homes, land investments and lifestyle properties. Your job is to understand their intent, educate them about the opportunity, nurture the relationship and ultimately get them to participate in a **Virtual Consultation (VC)** with our sales team.

The quality of the conversation matters more than the number of calls made.

What You Will Do  
1\. Build \& Manage a Prospect Pipeline

* Work on inbound leads generated through digital marketing, referrals, databases and other channels.
* Make structured outbound calls to prospective customers.
* Reconnect with older and dormant prospects to identify renewed interest.
* Understand the customer's purpose, budget, location preference, investment horizon and decision\-making stage.
* Maintain accurate prospect information and activity in the CRM.

2\. Qualify Through Conversation

Your role isn't to push a brochure or immediately ask for a site visit.

You will learn to identify:

* Genuine second\-home buyers
* Investment\-focused prospects
* Holiday rental/Airbnb investors
* Long\-term land investors
* Retirement and lifestyle buyers
* Customers who are simply exploring the market

The objective is to determine whether a prospect deserves a deeper conversation with our sales team.

3\. Convert Prospects into Virtual Consultations

This is the **primary outcome of the role**.

You will introduce prospects to our Virtual Consultation format, explain why it is useful, and secure a confirmed appointment.

The VC allows our team to take the customer through:

* The location and broader investment opportunity
* Project vision and masterplan
* Lifestyle proposition
* Investment potential
* Rental potential
* Legal and documentation aspects
* Pricing and commercial structure
* Customer\-specific questions

You will be responsible for **nurturing the prospect until they actually connect for the VC**, not simply marking an appointment as booked.

4\. Follow Up With Purpose

Real estate prospects rarely convert after one conversation.

You will be expected to build structured follow\-up journeys through:

* Phone calls
* WhatsApp conversations
* Email
* CRM tasks
* Personalised information sharing

The goal is to add value at every interaction rather than repeatedly asking, "Have you decided?"

5\. Work Closely With Sales

Once a prospect is successfully converted into a VC, you will coordinate with the Sales team and ensure a smooth handover.

You will also receive feedback on:

* VC quality
* Customer objections
* Customer intent
* Conversion outcomes

This feedback loop will help you progressively develop your sales ability.

How This Role Is Different

Traditional real estate presales often operates around:

**Lead → Call → Site Visit**

Our model is different:

**Lead → Understand → Educate → Nurture → Virtual Consultation → Site Experience → Conversion**

The **Virtual Consultation is the key milestone**.

Your incentives and performance metrics are therefore aligned primarily with the **number and quality of VCs successfully converted**, rather than simply calls made or leads contacted.

Who We're Looking For

You should ideally have:

* **1–3 years of experience** in presales, telesales, real estate sales or customer acquisition.
* Proven experience handling a large volume of prospects over the phone.
* Strong verbal communication and listening skills.
* The ability to hold a meaningful conversation rather than follow a rigid script.
* Comfort with persistent but respectful follow\-up.
* Basic understanding of CRM systems and digital communication tools.
* A genuine interest in developing a career in sales.

Most importantly

We are looking for someone who **wants to become a salesperson eventually**, but is comfortable earning that opportunity by first mastering the fundamentals:

**prospecting → qualification → communication → relationship building → follow\-up → conversion.**

You don't need to know everything about real estate today.

You need the curiosity and discipline to learn.

What You Can Expect

This role is designed as a **career pathway into sales**.

A successful Presales Associate can progressively take on greater responsibility across:

**Presales Associate → Sales Associate → Closing / Relationship Manager**

You will gain exposure to:

* Luxury and leisure real estate
* Investment\-led selling
* Second\-home decision making
* Customer psychology
* Virtual consultations
* Real estate investment frameworks
* CRM and sales technology
* AI\-assisted sales workflows
* Negotiation and closing

Performance \& Incentives

Your performance will be measured on outcomes, not vanity metrics.

Key metrics include:

* Meaningful conversations
* Qualified prospects
* VC bookings
* **VC attendance**
* Follow\-up effectiveness
* Pipeline quality
* Conversion contribution

**Incentives are directly aligned with successful VC conversions**, ensuring that the role rewards the ability to build genuine customer engagement rather than simply making calls.

The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here

You will do well if you:

* Enjoy talking to people.
* Don't give up after the first "I'm not interested."
* Know how to follow up without becoming irritating.
* Can listen before pitching.
* Are curious about why people make financial and lifestyle decisions.
* Want to build a career in consultative sales.
* Are willing to start from the fundamentals and earn your way into a closing role.

If your ambition is to eventually sit across the table from a customer and close a ₹50 lakh\+ second\-home transaction, **this is where you learn how to build the relationship that gets you there.**

Pay: ₹22,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Experience:

* real estate presales: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

81b4818b.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
81b4818b.description:
**Summary**
 Guidewire provides outstanding software for the second\-largest financial services industry in the world: insurance. We deliver the core applications that Property and Casualty (P/C) insurers use to build their products, sell policies, settle claims, and bill their customers. We deliver SaaS solutions via Guidewire Cloud that enable our customers to rapidly innovate and drive measurable value. Our Application Platform helps internal developers and customers build innovative insurance applications with the aim to boost developer productivity, establish a vendor ecosystem and leverage the latest cloud technologies.
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager, you will play a key role within Application Platform organization, driving projects internally (and with other teams). You will be responsible to drive and coordinate major platform and cloud service initiatives with the highest degree of complexity. Your impact will be felt across the organization. You will spend a significant proportion of your time developing the capabilities of the team as a whole.
   

  

**Job Description**
 What you’ll do
   

  

* Lead end‑to‑end planning and execution of complex, multi‑team technical programs across platform, cloud operations, product engineering, data, and security to support PDO’s goals in reliability, security, and gross margin improvement.
* Partner with engineering, product management, design, QA, business stakeholders, and infrastructure teams to define scope, problem statements, success metrics, and delivery milestones for initiatives such as GenAI “lifts,” cloud reliability improvements, and new platform capabilities.
* Develop, maintain, and continuously refine integrated program plans—including timelines, dependency maps, risk registers, and release plans—to ensure programs land on time, within scope, and with clearly defined business outcomes.
* Manage cross‑functional dependencies, proactively identify and remove blockers, and escalate risks with data‑driven options so teams can move quickly while maintaining quality, compliance, and customer trust.
* Facilitate agile ceremonies, technical deep dives, architecture and design discussions, and regular program syncs that align teams around priorities, trade‑offs, and delivery commitments across loosely coupled domains.
* Implement and evolve program governance, reporting cadences, and operational best practices that improve transparency, decision‑making, and execution efficiency across PDO and partner organizations.
* Define and own program‑level KPIs (e.g., reliability, incident metrics, development velocity, technical debt reduction, cloud and data platform adoption, infrastructure stability), track variances, and drive course‑corrections based on data and continuous feedback.
* Ensure technical readiness for production releases—including security posture, scalability, performance, disaster recovery dependencies, and operational health—aligned with Guidewire’s security and compliance standards.
* Collaborate with leadership to drive change management, refine processes, and align programs with Guidewire’s broader vision to embed AI and GenAI across products and operations, including initiatives like the Agentic AI Platform and cloud adoption accelerators.
* Influence platform and tooling direction by identifying opportunities to streamline developer workflows, improve operational efficiency, and better support AI, cloud, and data platform adoption across PDO and other teams.
* Manage relationships with vendors and third‑party service providers where applicable, including contract and SLA considerations, to ensure external dependencies support program outcomes and service reliability.
* Act as the “glue” that connects high‑velocity, distributed teams, ensuring alignment with Guidewire’s mission to transform how P\&C insurers operate through a secure, scalable, AI‑enabled cloud platform.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data\-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 12\+ years of total professional experience, including 5\+ years in technical program management driving complex, multi‑team software initiatives, preferably in cloud, infrastructure, or platform environments.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and agile or hybrid delivery models, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, product, operations, and security teams.
* Solid grasp of modern software architecture, cloud systems (e.g., distributed, multi‑tenant SaaS), and platform engineering concepts such as reliability, observability, and scalability.
* Proven track record of designing and running metrics‑driven programs: defining KPIs, building dashboards or reporting mechanisms, and using data to guide decisions, communicate impact, and improve program performance.
* Hands‑on experience with engineering planning and tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, Aha!, Confluence, Google Sheets) to manage backlogs, dependencies, and status reporting at scale.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex technical topics for executives and non‑technical partners, and to drive alignment among diverse viewpoints.
* Proficiency with change management principles and techniques—able to guide teams through new processes, tools, and ways of working while minimizing disruption and resistance.
* Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data\-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.


**Preferred Skills \& Experience**
* Experience leading programs related to cloud operations, platform reliability, AI/ML or GenAI features, or large‑scale data platforms.
* Background in or exposure to P\&C insurance or other highly regulated industries, particularly in cloud or SaaS environments.
* Experience with vendor management, including understanding of SLAs, contract implications, and how external partners fit into critical program paths.
* Prior experience in organizations undergoing significant cloud, AI, or data platform transformation, especially where operational excellence and innovation must be balanced.
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field—or equivalent demonstrated technical proficiency through experience.


 Your Impact
   

  

 We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first months, you’ll immerse yourself in PDO’s FY26 VPMOM, understand our AI, cloud, and data platform priorities, and take ownership of one or more high‑impact programs—such as reliability and security improvements, GenAI‑enabled product capabilities, or cross‑region disaster recovery and readiness initiatives.
   

  

 You’ll establish program structures, clarify goals and KPIs, and build trusted relationships with engineering, product, security, operations, and go‑to‑market leaders. As your programs mature, you’ll be accountable for measurable outcomes like improved service reliability, faster time‑to‑market for AI‑infused features, increased adoption of cloud and data platform capabilities, and reduced operational toil. Your work will directly support Guidewire’s mission to combine digital, core, analytics, and AI into a cloud platform that helps P\&C insurers operate more efficiently and deliver better experiences to their customers worldwide.
   

  

**About Guidewire**
 Guidewire is the platform P\&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540\+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.
   

  

 As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600\+ successful projects, supported by the largest R\&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.
   

  

 Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

4ec1bb60.description:
NVIDIA is looking for Senior Networking Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centers. * Primary responsibilities will include building AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers.
* Support operational and reliability aspects of large\-scale AI clusters, focusing on performance at scale, real\-time monitoring, logging, and alerting.

* Proficiency in configuring, testing, validating, and resolving issues in LAN networks, especially in medium to large\-scale HPC/AI environments.
* Advanced knowledge of EVPN, BGP, OSPF, VXLAN protocols.
* Hands\-on experience with network switch/router platforms like Cumulus Linux, SONiC, IOS, JunosOS, and EOS.
* Extensive experience delivering automated network provisioning solutions using tools like Ansible, Salt, and Python.
* Ability to develop CI/CD pipelines for network operations.
* Strong focus on customer needs and satisfaction.
* Self\-motivated with leadership skills to work collaboratively with customers and internal teams.
* Strong written, verbal, and listening skills in English are essential.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Familiarity with cloud networks (AWS, GCP, Azure) is a plus.
* Linux or Networking Certifications.
* Experience with High\-performance computing architectures. Understanding of how job schedulers (Slurm, PBS) work.

d5647361.description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
 For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client\-centric and digitally\-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
   

  

 Lexmark is now a proud part of Xerox, bringing together two trusted names and decades of expertise into a bold and shared vision.
   

  

 When you join us, you step into a technology ecosystem where your ideas, skills, and ambition can shape what comes next. Whether you’re just starting out or leading at the highest levels, this is a place to grow, stretch, and make real impact—across industries, countries, and careers.
   

  

 From engineering and products to digital services and customer experience, you’ll help connect data, devices, and people in smarter, faster ways. This is meaningful, connected work—on a global stage, with the backing of a company built for the future, and a robust benefits package designed to support your growth, well\-being, and life beyond work.
   

  

 This position is for a D365 Technical Architect supporting the Sales, Customer Service, Field Service and Project Services implementation.
   

  

**Overview:**
* Focuses on one or more major feature sets within the broader D365 domain.
* Collaborates with Product Owners, Functional Architects and Development teams that work within the related Delivery teams.
* Primarily engages with the delivery teams on current development initiatives from a design and implementation perspective.
* Also contributes to efforts to strengthen the application development infrastructure
* Helps shape the technical strategy for the applications within the D365 domain.


**Specific Responsibilities:**
* Analyzes business needs and user requirements to design and implement application solutions using the D365/Xrm platform, Azure components, and other integration\-related toolsets (SSIS, WebServices).
* Develop and maintain design artifacts representing the proposed technical solutions effectively.
* Stays up\-to\-date with the latest best practices and standards in the D365 and Azure platform.
* Work closely with delivery teams in an agile development environment, ensuring proper implementation and adoption of solutions.
* Drive testability (including automated testing, unit testing and user acceptance testing) and operational readiness in solution designs.
* Advocate for continuous improvement and adoption of best practices.
* Create designs that promote methods of configuration for agility and responsiveness.
* Conduct design and code reviews to maintain development quality.
* Ensure compliance with data security, licensing, and resource usage requirements.
* Assist business leaders with change management and user adoption in order to effectively use tools and systems
* Assist in planning for and adopting of Microsoft’s major and minor releases to maximize platform utilization.
* Summarize and communicate findings at an executive level


**Qualifications:**
* Required:
* 5\-15 years of relevant work experience
* Minimum 3 years’ experience with MS Dynamics 365 or related platforms
* Strong ability to communicate design concepts effectively.
* Deep development experience within the D365 technology stack
* Experience in business analysis
* Ability to organize information, prioritze tasks and adapt to changing priorities
* Experience working with a highly customized application
* Preferred:
* Experience with Mobile App Development, CRM portals and Data Migration
* Experience with Azure components such as Function Apps, Service Bus and Logic Apps
* Experience with SQL and Stored Procedures


**Education/Training:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required
* Industry Standard Technical Certifications desired.


**Knowledge, skills \& abilities:**
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Creative problem\-solving abilities and flexibility.
* Proactive approach to work and ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* Effective team player with the ability to collaborate across various levels of management.

 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

0a8b042f.title: Hybrid Cloud Architect
0a8b042f.description:
**About Us**
**PHINIA:** 
 Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow.
   

  

 PHINIA is an independent, market\-leading, premium solutions and components provider with over 100 years of manufacturing expertise and industry relationships, with a strong brand portfolio that includes DELPHI®, DELCO REMY® and HARTRIDGE™. With over 12,500 employees across 43 locations in 20 countries, PHINIA is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA.
   

  

 At PHINIA, we Provide fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket products and solutions of the highest quality — developed and manufactured responsibly — that are designed to enhance efficiency and reduce the environmental impact of vehicles, industrial machinery, and other applications. In doing so, we contribute to a cleaner tomorrow, treat our people and surrounding communities with respect, and hold ourselves accountable to robust ethical standards.
   

  

**Our Culture**
 PHINIA promotes and cultivates an inclusive culture and diverse perspectives, strives to maintain its reputation for excellence, thrives on the power of collaboration, and fosters the development of our talented employees. We believe in making a positive impact through our business and actions, and we take our collective responsibility seriously.
   

  

**Career Opportunities**
 We believe in building a brighter tomorrow for our employees as well as our customers and encourage you to learn about our long history, strong culture, new technologies, and future vision. We offer a strong local presence and interesting global opportunities. Join us on this shared journey toward a brighter tomorrow.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 PHINIA is seeking a Hybrid Cloud Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of PHINIA’s hybrid cloud ecosystem, spanning on‑premises infrastructure, private cloud, and public cloud platforms. This role ensures secure, scalable, cost‑efficient cloud architectures that align with PHINIA’s digital transformation strategy. The architect will guide cloud migration initiatives and governance standards while partnering closely with infrastructure, security, application, and business teams to deliver resilient hybrid cloud capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect hybrid cloud environments across on‑prem, private cloud, and public cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP).
* Lead hybrid infrastructure modernization, including cloud migration strategies and data center integration.
* Establish and enforce hybrid cloud governance models, compliance controls, FinOps principles and security standards in collaboration with PHINIA Security and IT governance teams.
* Develop disaster recovery, business continuity approaches, and hybrid failover patterns.
* Create and maintain hybrid cloud architectural documentation, integration diagrams, interface specifications, and operational runbooks.
* Evaluate emerging cloud technologies, recommend enhancements, and lead proof‑of‑concept initiatives.
* Collaborate with DevOps, Infrastructure, and Application teams to drive automation, IaC adoption, and CI/CD integration.
* Modernize workloads (ERP, MES, PLM, custom apps) using containers, Kubernetes, and cloud\-native services.
* Design secure OT/IT integration, industrial edge compute, and data pipelines (OPC‑UA, IoT, analytics).


**What we’re looking for:**
* Bachelor’s or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent work experience.
* 7\+ years of IT infrastructure experience with 4\+ years in cloud or hybrid architecture.
* Strong expertise in Azure (preferred), plus working knowledge of AWS/GCP.
* Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation), automation, CI/CD tooling and containerization (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Experience with OT systems and industrial protocols.
* Foundation in cloud security, Zero Trust, networking, and governance.
* Background in manufacturing/automotive environments is a strong preference.
* Certifications such as Azure/AWS Architect, TOGAF, or FinOps are plus.


**What We Offer**
 We provide compensation and benefits programs intended to attract, motivate, reward, and retain an incredibly talented, globally diverse workforce at all levels within our organization. Our compensation programs are informed by market data and business needs, and we are committed to providing equitable and competitive compensation. We are committed to providing our team with quality and competitive benefit programs, including health and well\-being resources, family\-centric policies, and an agile workplace program, where not precluded by collective bargaining agreements or national statutory plans. Plans are benchmarked for competitiveness and value.
   

  

 We provide formal development opportunities at all levels and stages of employee careers. These opportunities are delivered in a variety of formats to make our portfolio of solutions agile, sustainable, and scalable to support our employees in developing the skills needed to succeed.
   

  

**What We Believe**
* Product Leadership \- Innovation that brings value to our customers
* Humility \- Seeking out diverse perspectives and working collaboratively
* Inclusivity \- Recognizing our differences makes us stronger; we are bold and intentional
* Net\-Zero \- Committed to energy efficiency, waste reduction and beneficial reuse
* Integrity \- Taking responsibility for our decisions and doing what is right
* Accountability \- Taking ownership of our actions and driving results


**SAFETY**
 You will consistently hear us say Safety First! We are committed to continually improving our strong safety performance supporting the health and wellness of our employees!
   

  

 We also believe employee health and safety is everyone’s responsibility. We encourage safety learning and collaboration to help employees understand and follow applicable safety policies, standards, and procedures and identify opportunities to minimize or eliminate risk. Work is expected to be conducted in a manner that stresses the importance of preventing incidents and illnesses, including attending all required safety meetings and trainings. It is expected that all incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions are immediately reported to the direct manager, Human Resources, or Safety Representative.
   

  

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
 PHINIA is an equal employment opportunity employer such that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
   

  

**VISA SPONSORSHIP**
 PHINIA does provide sponsorship for employment visa status based on business need. However, for this role, applicants must be currently authorized to work on a full\-time basis, in the country where the position is currently based.
   

  

**NO UNAUTHORIZED REFERRALS FROM RECRUITERS \& VENDORS**
 Please note that PHINIA does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or offers from third party recruiters or staffing agencies associated with any published or unpublished employment opportunities. Any unsolicited information sent to PHINIA will be considered as unencumbered and free from any fee or charge whatsoever. Only members of our Human Resources Team have the authority to engage or authorize recruiting services, which must be agreed upon before the unsolicited resume or offer is received.
   

  

**GLOBAL TERMS OF USE AND PRIVACY STATEMENT**
 Carefully read the PHINIA Privacy Policy before using this website. Your ability to access and use this website and apply for a job at PHINIA are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.
   

  

 Please access the linked document by clicking here, select the geographical area where you are applying for employment, and review.
   

  

 Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the terms.
   

  

***Career Scam Disclaimer:***
*PHINIA makes no representations or guarantees regarding employment opportunities listed on any third\-party website. To protect against career scams, job applicants should take the necessary precautions when interviewing for and accepting employment positions allegedly offered by PHINIA. Applicants should never provide their national ID numbers, birth dates, credit card numbers, bank account information or other private information when communicating with prospective employers or responding to employment opportunities online. Job applicants are invited to contact PHINIA through PHINIA’s website to verify the authenticity of any employment opportunities.*
 Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow. Join us on this shared journey to a brighter tomorrow. For more information about PHINIA, please visit www.phinia.com.

1f829567.title: Solution Architect
1f829567.description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** 
 It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers
   

  

**Job Title** 
 IT Manager, Supply Chain Planning –End to End Supply Chain Solution Architect \& KTLO Management
   

  

**Location** 
 Hyderabad, India
   

  

**Job Summary** 
 We are seeking an experienced and dynamic IT Manager, Supply Chain Planning who will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the technology solution that supports global supply chain operations—from demand planning and procurement through manufacturing, logistics, and fulfillment with the focus on, but not limited to, supply chain special programs under the supervision of principle solution architect as well as overseeing the "Keep the Lights On" (KTLO) operations across all planning functions and applications, ensuring seamless supported day\-to\-day supply chain activities. This role bridges business strategy with technical execution, ensuring scalable, integrated, and future\-ready solutions across existing legacy systems, future ERP, MES, WMS, TMS, and planning systems. The candidate must be willing to work on site 4 days a week in Hyderabad, during US EST time zone.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**End to End Supply Chain Solution**
* Solution Architecture \& Design
* Lead architecture design for global supply chain solutions, including planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and order fulfillment under the supervision of the principle solution architect.
* Develop target\-state solutions aligned with enterprise standards and digital transformation goals across existing legacy systems, future ERP (SAP, Oracle, etc.), PLM, MES, WMS, TMS, and external partner systems.
* Ensure solutions alignment with business processes and KPIs for supply chain efficiency, visibility, and sustainability.
* Solution Delivery \& Governance
* Collaborate with delivery teams to ensure adherence to architectural principles and design standards.
* Provide technical leadership during project execution, including vendor selection and design reviews.
* Maintain documentation of architecture artifacts and ensure compliance with security, data, and integration standards.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Partner with business units (Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Customer Service) to define functional requirements.
* Work closely with enterprise architects, data architects, and infrastructure teams to ensure holistic solutions.
* Liaise with external technology partners, system integrators, and SaaS providers.


**KTLO Operations Management**
* Oversee supported supply chain activities daily to ensure uninterrupted operations across all supported business units that includes but not limited to planning.
* Maintain and optimize (planning) systems and processes to support consistent product availability and service levels across all supported business units.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to address operational challenges and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
* Identify and address IT issues as primary point of contact and optimize infrastructure, hardware, software and processes, in close partnership with the GSC business team and driving GTO dependencies
* Engage in rigorous root cause analysis, problem solving and solution implementations
* Ensure system processes work in a manner that adheres to customer requirements
* Maintain and update systems and data – combination of legacy systems and Salesforce platforms
* Ability to identify systems problems, solution fixes, present to leadership, and implement changes


**Leadership and Management**
* Lead the planning and execution of special programs, including franchise expansions, portfolio adjustments, and new business trials.
* Lead and manage a team of technical resources located offshore, ensuring high performance, motivation, and professional development.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to align program objectives with overall business goals and supply chain capabilities.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning within the planning team


**Franchise \& Portfolio Planning**
* Analyze and manage the supply chain aspects of franchise operations, ensuring alignment with market demands and strategic objectives.
* Evaluate portfolio performance and implement planning adjustments to optimize product mix, inventory levels, and distribution strategies.
* Lead and support any Franchise and Portfolio initiatives and relevant system enhancements that includes but not limited to planning systems.


**New Business Integration**
* Collaborate with business development teams to assess supply chain implications of new business opportunities.
* Design and implement (planning) processes to support the successful launch and integration of new programs like AG International.
* Monitor and report on the performance of new initiatives, providing insights for continuous improvement.


**Project Deliverables** 
 Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of technical projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and within budget.
   

  

**Collaboration** 
 Work closely with onshore teams, to align offshore activities with overall business objectives and project goals. Must be able and willing to jump in hands on any administrative, production support, Project management and/or business analyst tasks as needed.
   

  

**Resource Allocation** 
 Efficiently allocate and manage technical resources to meet project / operation demands and optimize productivity.
   

  

**Quality Assurance** 
 Implement and maintain quality assurance processes to ensure the highest standards of technical delivery.
   

  

**Communication** 
 Facilitate effective communication between offshore and onshore teams, ensuring transparency and alignment on project status, risks, and issues.
   

  

**Problem Solving** 
 Proactively identify and resolve technical and operational challenges to ensure smooth project execution.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management** 
 Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, providing regular updates and addressing any concerns or requirements.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Education Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field. Or 10\+ years in similar IT solution roles focusing on planning and supply chain operations in consumer product industries.
* Experience Minimum of 8 years of experience in IT solution architecture with at least 4 years focusing on supply chain planning systems and at least 3 years in a managerial role. Deep understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain process and applications is a MUST. Expert in application support including problem analysis and resolution. Strong analytical and critical thinking mindset. Expert relationship management/networking skills with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Comfortable presenting to business stakeholders on a regular basis and Should be able to work independently under minimal supervision and be a good team player.
* Technical Skills Strong understanding of software development, IT infrastructure, and project delivery methodologies and
+ Must have experience in Anaplan, Blue Yonder ESP/Fulfillment, ETL tools like Informatica, Ascend, , Cloudworks. Porficient in SQL, Excel, JIRA.
+ Nice to have \- Google cloud, Data Quality and Governance .

* Leadership Skills Proven ability to lead and inspire technical teams, with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Problem\-Solving Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
* Cultural Awareness Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and highly dynamic environment and manage teams across different time zones. Must be multi\-tasker and able to adapt, prioritize and deliver assignments with the highest quality under pressure with short deadlines.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with advanced planning systems (e.g., SAP IBP, Oracle SCM Cloud, BY ESP), Anaplan, OMS and WMS a strong plus.
* Knowledge of project management methodologies and tools.


 Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
   

  

**How We Work**
 We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors
   

  

* We collaborate Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* We innovate At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* We execute We are a performance\-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best\-in\-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.


**Our Approach to Flexible Work:**
 We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in\-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher\-Price, American Girl, Thomas \& Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.
   

  

 Mattel’s award\-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.
   

  

 Visit us at https //jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers .
