7473f3fb.title: Digital Payments Architect
7473f3fb.description:
Digital Payments Architect — National UPI Implementation (Guyana Program)
 
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (Hybrid) \|
 **Type:** 
 Full\-time
 **Practice:** 
 Digital Payments \& FinTech \|
 **Engagement:** 
 Government of Guyana National UPI Rollout, in partnership with NPCI International Payments Ltd (NIPL)
 


 About The Ksquare Group
 
 The Ksquare Group is a global consulting company that delivers cutting\-edge technological solutions through customized projects that improve decision\-making with speed and quality. By partnering with leading technology providers, Ksquare accelerates digital transformation initiatives for its clients across industries and geographies. Our teams work in a dynamic environment focused on innovation, collaboration, and measurable business impact.
 


 About the Program
 
 The Government of Guyana is implementing a national real\-time digital payments platform based on India's Unified Payments Interface (UPI), in partnership with NPCI International Payments Ltd (NIPL). Ksquare has been entrusted with end\-to\-end ownership of this program — from the UPI platform implementation, working hand\-in\-hand with the NIPL/UPI India team, through to onboarding the country's banking institutions and driving merchant and business adoption once the platform is live.
 



 This is a rare opportunity to architect and operationalize a nation's digital payments backbone from the ground up.
 


 Role Description
 
 The Digital Payments Architect will be Ksquare's senior\-most technical owner for the UPI program. You will represent Ksquare in all technical engagements with the NIPL/UPI India implementation team, own the end\-to\-end solution architecture for the UPI deployment in Guyana, and lead the technical onboarding of banks, payment service providers (PSPs), and merchants onto the platform.
 



 We are looking for someone who has
 **done this before** 
 — a practitioner who has been part of a UPI or comparable national instant\-payments deployment (implementation, bank integration, or ecosystem rollout) and can take full ownership from Ksquare's side.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**Phase 1 — UPI Platform Implementation (with NIPL / UPI India team)** 



* Serve as Ksquare's technical counterpart and single point of ownership with the NIPL/UPI India implementation team throughout deployment.
* Own the end\-to\-end solution architecture: UPI switch deployment, core infrastructure, network topology, security architecture, and integration with the national banking ecosystem and central bank systems.
* Define system and integration patterns for bank connectivity (issuer/acquirer/PSP integrations), including messaging standards (ISO 8583 / ISO 20022 / UPI APIs), tokenization, and settlement flows.
* Drive environment setup, sandbox testing, NPCI\-style certification cycles, UAT, and go\-live readiness for the platform and participating institutions.
* Ensure the architecture meets requirements for security, scalability, high availability, disaster recovery, and regulatory compliance (including engagement with the Bank of Guyana and relevant regulators).



**Phase 2 — Ecosystem Ownership: Bank \& Merchant Onboarding** 



* Own the technical onboarding roadmap for all banking institutions in Guyana: integration design, certification, testing, and production cutover for each bank.
* Define and standardize onboarding playbooks, API specifications, integration kits, and certification checklists for banks, PSPs, and payment aggregators.
* Lead merchant and business enablement from the platform side: QR standards, merchant acquiring flows, payment gateway/aggregator integrations, and support for merchant\-facing applications.
* Establish operational frameworks post\-go\-live: dispute resolution and chargeback handling, reconciliation and settlement operations, fraud and risk monitoring, uptime/SLA management.
* Act as the ongoing technical authority for the UPI ecosystem in Guyana, coordinating between government stakeholders, NIPL, banks, and merchants.



**Ongoing** 



* Guide and mentor Ksquare's engineering and integration teams delivering on the program.
* Review solution designs, manage technical risk, and support program planning and stakeholder communication at the executive and government level.
* Document architectures clearly and communicate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including government and central bank stakeholders.


 QualificationsMust\-Have
 * **Direct, hands\-on experience with UPI** 
 — as part of NPCI/NIPL programs, a bank's UPI stack, a PSP/TPAP (e.g., building or integrating UPI payment apps), a UPI switch/technology provider, or an international UPI deployment. Candidates who have led or played a core role in a national or large\-scale instant\-payments rollout (UPI, IMPS, or comparable schemes such as PIX, PromptPay, or Aani) will be strongly preferred.
* Deep expertise in payments architecture for complex, distributed, high\-availability, high\-TPS systems: switching, routing, settlement, reconciliation.
* Strong knowledge of UPI ecosystem mechanics: NPCI certification processes, PSP/issuer/acquirer roles, VPA/alias resolution, QR specifications (including interoperable QR), mandates/AutoPay, and dispute management (e.g., URCS or equivalent).
* Expertise in system and API integration: bank core systems (CBS), payment gateways, aggregators, and third\-party services; messaging standards including ISO 8583 and ISO 20022\.
* Strong grounding in payments security and compliance: PCI DSS, encryption/HSM usage, tokenization, fraud and risk management frameworks, and regulatory/central\-bank compliance.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and microservices\-based architectures, including on\-prem/hybrid deployment models common in central\-bank environments.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-party programs: coordinating across government bodies, regulators, scheme operators (NPCI/NIPL), multiple banks, and internal teams across locations and time zones.
* Hands\-on software development background in modern languages and frameworks relevant to payments (e.g., Java, Go, Node.js).
* Excellent documentation, stakeholder communication, and executive presentation skills.


 Good\-to\-Have
 * Experience with international UPI expansion programs or cross\-border payment corridors.
* Experience onboarding banks or merchants onto a payments scheme at scale (integration programs, certification management).
* Familiarity with national digital public infrastructure (DPI) initiatives, financial inclusion programs, or central bank digital payment strategies.
* Exposure to emerging\-market or Caribbean/LatAm banking environments.
* Advanced certifications in architecture (e.g., TOGAF) or payments.


 Education
 * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; advanced degrees or payments certifications are a plus.


 What Makes This Role Unique
 * Own a
 **country\-level payments transformation** 
 — not a feature, not a module, an entire national ecosystem.
* Work directly with the
 **NPCI International (UPI India) team** 
 on one of the first sovereign UPI deployments outside India.
* Long\-term ownership: you build it, you scale it, you run the ecosystem.

2160e62a.title: Technical Program Manager
2160e62a.description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Senior Technical Program Manager** to drive complex technical programs, product releases, customer migrations, and operational excellence across the organization.

In this role, you will work closely with **Product, Engineering, QA, Security, SRE, Customer\-facing teams, and other cross\-functional stakeholders** to plan and deliver major product releases and migrations from end to end.

You will play a key role in ensuring that products are not only developed successfully but are also **release\-ready, operationally stable, and able to deliver measurable value to customers and the business.**

This is a high\-ownership role that requires strong technical understanding, strategic thinking, excellent communication, and the ability to influence teams without direct authority.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Release \& Program Management**

* Lead end\-to\-end technical programs and product release initiatives across multiple teams.
* Develop and manage release plans and calendars for high\-impact product initiatives.
* Drive release readiness across Engineering, QA, Security, SRE, Support, and other stakeholders.
* Track dependencies, milestones, risks, and critical decisions to ensure successful releases.
* Identify potential release risks early and develop mitigation plans.
* Challenge unrealistic timelines and help teams establish achievable delivery plans.

**Customer Migration**

* Plan and coordinate customer migrations and product upgrades from one version or platform to another.
* Work closely with Engineering, Product, and customer\-facing teams to ensure migration readiness.
* Identify migration risks, dependencies, and potential customer impact.
* Coordinate migration activities to minimize disruption to the customer experience.
* Track migration outcomes and drive resolution of issues that impact successful adoption.

**Technical \& Operational Leadership**

* Work closely with engineering and SRE teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Understand technical dependencies across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and production environments.
* Drive operational readiness, production stability, security, and reliability across programs.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and optimize costs.
* Use program metrics, dashboards, and data to identify bottlenecks and risks.

**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management**

* Independently lead cross\-functional meetings, working sessions, and program reviews.
* Align distributed and cross\-geographical teams around priorities, timelines, and outcomes.
* Influence stakeholders and drive decisions without direct reporting authority.
* Present program status, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Establish structure and operating rhythms in ambiguous or evolving environments.

**AI\-Enabled Program Management**

* Leverage Gen\-AI and AI\-enabled tools to improve program execution and operational efficiency.
* Use AI and automation where appropriate to identify risks, surface bottlenecks, summarize program information, and streamline reporting.
* Explore innovative approaches to improve program visibility, decision\-making, and execution.

**What You Need to Succeed**

* **12\+ years of overall professional experience**, including at least **5 years of Technical Program Management experience**.
* Strong experience leading complex, cross\-functional technical programs in a fast\-paced software/product environment.
* Strong understanding of **SDLC and software/product development processes**.
* Experience with **product release management, release readiness, and production readiness**.
* Experience managing **customer, product, platform, or cloud migrations**.
* Understanding of SaaS, cloud/infrastructure, and engineering environments.
* Experience working with Engineering, Product, QA, Security, SRE, and customer\-facing teams.
* Experience with operational stability, cost optimization, risk management, and program governance.
* Strong ability to independently drive programs and lead leadership reviews with minimal supervision.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to influence and drive outcomes without direct authority.
* Practical knowledge or experience using **Gen\-AI/AI tools** for productivity, automation, reporting, analysis, or program management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Master's degree is a plus.
* PMP, PgMP, or other relevant program/project management certifications are a plus.
* Experience working with large\-scale SaaS or enterprise software products.
* Experience working with geographically distributed engineering and product teams.
* Experience driving programs involving large\-scale product releases or customer migrations.

Pay: ₹2,500,000\.00 \- ₹3,500,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Lenovo’s continued investment in world\-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992\) (ADR: LNVGY).  

  

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world\-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
### **Description and Requirements**

* This position is with an Infrastructure Management team. The chosen candidate will have primary responsibilities across both Windows and Linux systems and applications, with overall functionality of the environment being a shared responsibility across all members of the infrastructure team. The environment is not static, and duties assigned will change as the environment grows or evolves; all team members are expected to be flexible in both skills and schedule.  

The infrastructure team manages, maintains, and supports an isolated environment which facilitates delivery of several Appliance Management and Systems Management Services to customers. This position requires significant hands\-on experience with Windows Server platforms, Active Directory, systems management, and security configurations, as well as strong working knowledge of Linux\-based systems in production environments.  

The candidate will be responsible for building, configuring, optimizing, patching, maintaining, and securing both Windows and Linux systems. This includes applying security fixes and remediation plans, documenting procedures, diagramming systems, responding to alerts and incidents through the ticketing system, and maintaining proper configuration and operational records.  

On the Windows side, the role includes administration and support of technologies such as Active Directory, Microsoft SQL Server, Exchange, and SharePoint. On the Linux side, the role includes administration of enterprise Linux distributions (such as Red Hat, Rocky, or Ubuntu), managing system services, performance tuning, patching, log analysis, storage and filesystem management, and supporting applications hosted on Linux platforms.  

In addition, the candidate will be required to learn and support applications running on both Windows and Linux systems in order to maintain operational stability. Current applications include SolarWinds Orion, Password Manager Pro, AD Manager, and AD Audit, as well as Linux\-hosted services supporting monitoring, automation, or infrastructure tooling.

* Advanced Windows Server administration skills with certification and 5\+ years of experience, or 10\+ years of equivalent relevant work experience.
* Strong Linux system administration experience, including command\-line troubleshooting, service management, patching, and security hardening in production environments.
* Experience supporting Microsoft SQL (including clustered environments), Exchange email systems, or SharePoint.
* Solid troubleshooting, documentation, and operational support skills across mixed OS environments.
* Language Skills – fluent in spoken and written English.  

  

**Bonus:**
* Experience administering mixed Windows and Linux enterprise environments.
* Experience with email systems, monitoring platforms, or infrastructure management tools.
* Experience with security remediation, vulnerability management, and system hardening.
* Familiarity with automation or scripting (PowerShell, Bash, or similar).

db8de026.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
db8de026.description:
Neysa Mumbai Metropolitan Region
   

  

****About The Role****
 We are building a next\-generation cloud platform designed to power AI, enterprise, and high\-performance computing (HPC) workloads. As a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, deploying, automating, and operating highly available compute, virtualization, storage, networking, and Kubernetes infrastructure across both private and public cloud environments.
   

  

 In this role, you will work across the full infrastructure stack—from Linux systems, virtualization, storage, and networking to Kubernetes orchestration and infrastructure automation\- ensuring our platform is scalable, resilient, secure, and operationally efficient.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with engineering, and customer\-facing teams to deliver reliable cloud infrastructure, optimize performance, automate deployments, and troubleshoot complex production environments.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, building automation\-first platforms, and operating mission\-critical cloud infrastructure at scale.
   

  

****What You Will Be Doing:****
* Work with multiple cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure and/or your own!) to create an infrastructure that seamlessly stitches everything together.
* Build and maintain automatic scaling and reducing algorithms for infrastructure and software services.
* Identify points of failure and design around them. Create and simulate failure scenarios to test and verify your design choices.
* Work deeply with ancillary technologies, viz. networking, storage, load balancing, DNS, DHCP, logging, etc.
* Interact with developers to optimize placement, understand cost structures to optimize expenses, and design bespoke infrastructure deployment rules.


****What We Need To See:****
**Core virtualization and Storage (10\+ years)**
* Have a (very) deep understanding of virtualization, cloud computing, containers and automation across KVM, VMware, AWS, GCP and Azure.
* Have a strong understanding of Storage Systems i.e. Block, iSCSI, NFS, FC (Fibre Channel) and Scale\-Out.
* Have intermediate or advance level understanding of Container Orchestration like Kubernetes, Docker Swarm and Nomad.
* Be intimate with security concepts like firewalling, API security, placement policies, load balancing and availability.
* Be an expert in automation and automation frameworks. You should be able to design, write and troubleshoot automation scripts across platforms. Which include (but not limited to) Bash (Shell), PowerShell, Python, Terraform
* Understand how infrastructure components like DHCP, DNS, messaging queueing mechanisms, logging etc. work.
* Have a strong, intuitive approach to troubleshooting complex, multi\-domain issues.
* Have experience on cloud networking and extranets.
* Have an understanding of encryption, its effect on infrastructure services, and its suitability.


****Ways To Stand Out From The Rest:****
* The initiative to work independently, at your own pace, but on a schedule
* Intuitive about what is a problem now and what could be a problem down the line
* Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKS) or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)
* Good understanding of Networking
* Linux certifications


****Minimum Qualifications:****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience
* 4\+ years of Linux systems administration and data center deployment
* Soft Skills:
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging abilities across hardware, kernel, and application layers
* Ownership mindset with accountability for deployment quality and customer success
* Cross\-functional collaboration with other teams
* Proactive approach to continuous learning and staying current with AI infrastructure trends
* Strong documentation and presentation skills, able to defend design decisions amongst peers.

Requisition ID: 1725193
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

* Team and People Management: Mentor and lead large, cross\-functional teams of data engineers, data scientists, and architects, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning and managing performance and professional development.
* Innovation and Thought Leadership: Stay updated with the latest technology advancements and drive innovation within the firm and for clients, defining best practices.

  


**Required Skills and Qualifications**

  


* **Experience:** Typically requires 15\+ years of relevant industry experience in AI, data analytics, software development, or consulting, with a significant portion in a leadership or management role.

* Hands on knowledge with all Big data and cloud data engineering stack
* Strong technical and hands on experience in building analytics applications

**Soft Skills:** Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical details into clear business strategies for non\-technical stakeholders.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

bfc8b6fb.title: Pre-Sales Consultant
bfc8b6fb.description:
**SURYA AT A GLANCE** 
 Surya creates software products and provides implementation services for financial risk management of banks and the financial services industry. We provide web\-based, shared facility treasury management products for corporates. Founded in 1999, Surya’s client base is spread across four continents. We help more than 75\+ banks, hedge funds, and corporations around the world make better business decisions by mitigating risk, enhancing profitability, and complying with regulatory requirements. We are headquartered in Bangalore, India. We also have offices in Dubai, UK, USA and France.
   

  

* Designation: Pre\-Sales Consultant
* Relevant Experience: 2 \- 4 Years
* Qualification: MBA (Finance/Banking), CA, CFA, FRM, B.Com, M.Com, BBM, BE/B.Tech or equivalent qualification


**Roles And Responsibilities**
 As a Pre\-Sales Consultant, you will support business development and sales engagements by understanding client requirements, positioning Surya’s solutions, and demonstrating the value of our products to banks, financial institutions, and corporate customers. The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Delivery teams across the complete sales lifecycle.
   

  

* Attend client requirement discussions and understand business, functional, and solution needs.
* Conduct product demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, workshops, and presentations for prospective customers.
* Prepare and submit responses for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and other proposal\-related documentation.
* Prepare solution decks, product write\-ups, proposal content, business presentations, and customer\-facing collateral.
* Provide content support for certifications, ratings, analyst questionnaires, industry assessments, and related submissions.
* Work collaboratively with Field Sales, Sales Operations, Inside Sales, Product, and Delivery teams to support sales opportunities.
* Assist in solution positioning, proposal preparation, proof\-of\-concept discussions, and customer clarifications.
* Stay updated on banking, financial risk management, regulatory developments, and competitive product offerings.
* Travel to customer locations for meetings, demonstrations, workshops, and business development activities as required


**Required Skills**
*Functional*
* Good understanding of banking and financial services industry.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and map them to product capabilities.
* Exposure to Treasury, ALM, Liquidity Risk, Market Risk, IRRBB, FTP, Basel II/III, Stress Testing, or related risk management areas is desirable.
* Ability to prepare customer\-facing solution proposals, presentations, and business write\-ups.


*Technical*
* Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word – Mandatory.
* Ability to create clear solution decks, product collateral, and proposal documents.
* SQL basics and understanding of databases – Good to have.
* Understanding of enterprise software products and implementation lifecycle is an added advantage.


**Other Essential Skills**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong presentation, listening, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively across multiple teams.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Flexible and positive approach to work with willingness to travel based on business requirements.


**Preferred Experience**
* Prior experience in software product pre\-sales, solution consulting, business consulting, or client\-facing product demonstrations.
* Prior exposure to Financial Risk Management products or banking product pre\-sales will be an added advantage.
* Experience working with banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, fintech organizations, or enterprise software companies is preferred

 Click Here to know more : LIFE AT EXIGO TECH

 Exigo Tech is seeking a dynamic and driven Business Development Manager to join our team. **Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Security Pre\-Sales

 Security Assessments

 Solution Design \& Coordination
 


* Translate customer requirements into technical outcomes.

* Coordinate handover from sales to delivery teams.
* Ensure agreed customer outcomes are clearly documented and communicated.



 Technical Delivery
 


* Continue to perform Microsoft 365 migrations and tenant configuration activities.
* Implement Microsoft security technologies and security controls.
* Configure Conditional Access, Identity Protection, Microsoft Defender, and related security solutions.
* Assist project teams with implementation and remediation activities.



 IT Support Security Enablement
 


* Support the IT Support team with security\-related escalations, queries, and remediation guidance.
* Assist with security triage and investigation across Microsoft 365, identity, endpoint, and email security scenarios.
* Provide guidance on secure configuration, access controls, MFA, Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender, and related security controls.
* Support the uplift of IT Support capability through knowledge sharing, documentation, and repeatable security processes.
* Ensure security risks identified through support tickets are documented, escalated, and actioned appropriately.



  





**Essential Qualifications \& Experience:** 




  





 Education
 


* Degree, Diploma, or equivalent qualification in Information Technology, Cyber Security, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Relevant Microsoft Security certifications or demonstrated equivalent practical experience.



  





 Experience
 


* Minimum 3 years' experience working in Microsoft 365, Azure, or Cyber Security consulting, engineering, or managed services environments.
* Hands\-on experience implementing and supporting Microsoft security technologies, including:
* Microsoft Defender Suite
* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
* Conditional Access
* Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA)
* Identity Protection
* Microsoft Secure Score
* Microsoft 365 Security \& Compliance
* Experience conducting security assessments, audits, or security posture reviews and presenting recommendations to customers.
* Experience translating business and technical requirements into security solutions and implementation outcomes.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 tenant administration, identity management, and cloud security principles.
* Experience supporting customer\-facing engagements, workshops, technical presentations, and solution discussions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong documentation, time management, and problem\-solving skills.



  





 Technical Knowledge
 


* Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and best practices, including one or more of:
* Essential Eight
* Microsoft Security Adoption Framework
* CIS Controls
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework
* ISO 27001

 At Exigo Tech, we value diversity and encourage individuals to bring their unique personalities and characteristics to the role. We are not only looking for specific skills but also for individuals who will contribute to our vibrant work culture.

 If you are excited about this opportunity and meet the qualifications outlined above, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your resume, and we will reach out if your skills align with our needs.

cfa9b3ab.description:
**Description**
 The Audits and Insights team (AIT) – SPT Audit program measures accuracy of account enforcements, listing enforcements, all appeals and reinstatement decisions through audits on a statistically significant sample across Perfect Order Experience, Selling Partner Risk \& Abuse, Financial Disincentives, Automated Brand Protection, Andon, Product Review Abuse, Restricted Products, Safety, Know Your Customer \& Product Safety \& Compliance (PSC) to name a few. We perform audits and measure the coverage and accuracy via director level goals and generate actionable insights from our audits to improve enforcement accuracy, appeal handling accuracy, First Contact Resolution (FCR) rate and eliminate unnecessary Seller friction by identifying ways to reduce Seller enforcements and appeals. We are committed to maintaining and advancing the trust of our Sellers by raising the bar through our Audits.
   

  

 The QA \& Training Manager III is a senior leadership position responsible for directing and managing Quality, Dispute and Training Programs. This role requires strategic vision, executive\-level communication skills, and the ability to drive organizational change while ensuring operational excellence.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the QA, Dispute and Training function in AIT
* Drive a Zero Defect culture by managing process adherence and ensure implementation of controls to minimize.
* Conduct 5 Whys Analysis/ Fish Bone Analysis to identify error root causes and trends
* Analyze historical data to build quality improvement initiatives and drive quality, training and dispute management strategies across the Org.
* Liaise with Audit Operations to calibrate on QA result, dispute received and implement best practices to ensure auditors are constantly evolving, learning and improving.
* Monitor and report on Quality, Dispute and Training metrics in Business Reviews.
* Embrace constant change with flexibility and good grace which demands strong deliverables.
* Lead a large\-scale audit organization, including managers and senior auditors, ensuring high performance standards and professional growth
* Drive organizational transformation and change management initiatives
* Establish governance frameworks and quality assurance programs
* Build and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders across the business to shape audit process and risk management approaches
* Influence policy decisions and strategic direction at an organizational level
* Monitor and analyze audit metrics, providing regular reports to senior management
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and process optimization
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal standards


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of team management experience
* 5\+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Bachelor's degree in Technology, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field; Master's degree preferred
* Professional certification such as PMP, CIA, or CISA is highly desirable
* 7\+ years of experience in program management, preferably in audit or risk management roles
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
* 7\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* 5\+ years of data visualization and reports tools experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

54ba8090.title: Cloud Engineer
54ba8090.description:
**Company Description** 
 AI Vidya is a training and career enablement organization focused on developing future leaders in artificial intelligence. The company provides personalized AI training programs designed to help individuals build practical, industry\-relevant skills. With dedicated job assistance and expert guidance, AI Vidya supports learners throughout their career journey in the digital age. The organization emphasizes confidence\-building, skill mastery, and ongoing mentorship to help participants thrive in the fast\-paced world of AI. Joining AI Vidya means being part of a community that aims to lead and innovate in the evolving AI landscape.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time remote Cloud Engineer role. The Cloud Engineer will design, build, and maintain cloud\-based infrastructure to support AI Vidya’s training platforms and internal systems. Responsibilities include implementing scalable and secure cloud solutions, managing Linux\-based servers, configuring and monitoring databases, and optimizing performance and reliability across environments. The role involves collaborating with software development teams to deploy applications, automate workflows, and improve CI/CD pipelines. The Cloud Engineer will also troubleshoot production issues, implement best practices for security and cost optimization, and contribute to documentation and operational standards.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong foundation in Cloud Computing and Infrastructure, including experience with major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and infrastructure\-as\-code tools.
* Proficiency in Linux administration and systems management, including monitoring, security hardening, and automation using shell scripting or similar tools.
* Hands\-on experience with Databases (SQL and/or NoSQL), including configuration, performance tuning, backup strategies, and high availability.
* Software Development skills with at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and version control (e.g., Git).
* Understanding of networking concepts (VPCs, subnets, load balancers, firewalls) and cloud security best practices.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and prior exposure to AI or data platforms is a plus.

79999ce1.title: Solutions Architect - AI Platform
79999ce1.description:
**About Vericence** 




 Vericence is a digital engineering and technology consulting firm helping enterprises build AI\-driven platforms, modernize legacy systems, and scale innovation through cloud, data, and intelligent engineering. We partner with global organizations to deliver high\-impact technology solutions and build world\-class engineering teams.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are building an AI\-Native platform that autonomously ingests existing enterprise systems, user stories, and source code to deliver end\-to\-end software features with minimal human intervention. As Solution Architect, you will own the solution integrity of the entire platform, guiding a set of client stakeholders and internal stakeholders through valid deployment and implementation models for Context Graph, Event Orchestrator, Connectors, and Agent Development modules. You will be an expert in understanding SDLC and STLC lifecycles and can clearly come up with transformation levers for client implementations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Define and own the end\-to\-end solution blueprint for the AI platform across all modules.
* Establish transformation guidelines, operating model standards, implementation approach, specific data and information needs for the platform.
* Lead solution reviews, drive trade\-off decisions, and ensure alignment across module leads.
* Partner with the Principal Architect and Engineering Manager to translate product requirements into scalable solution strategy for clients.
* Provide feedback based on client implementations back to the platform and product teams.
* Oversee integration and implementation architecture between Client teams and Platform teams cutting across Context Graph, Event Orchestrator, Connectors, and Agent Development subsystems.
* Provide Solution and stakeholder mentorship to solution teams and product teams.
* Provide feedback on observability, security, and compliance standards for an AI\-native SDLC platform.
* Engage with executive stakeholders to communicate roadmap direction and roadmap risks.
* Drive proof\-of\-concepts for emerging AI/ML capabilities and evaluate their production readiness.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* 15\+ years of software engineering experience with at least 5 years in solution architect or transformational leader roles.
* Deep expertise in solutioning, designing, and transforming large\-scale distributed systems, microservices, and event\-driven architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with LLM\-based systems, RAG pipelines, knowledge graphs, or AI agent frameworks.
* Proficiency with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and container orchestration (Kubernetes).
* Experience with graph databases (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune) and vector stores (Pinecone, Weaviate).
* Strong background in digital and technology transformation of large enterprise clients.
* Proven ability to lead solution architecture across multiple concurrent client engineering teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both technical and executive audiences.
* Experience in Healthcare, Retail, or enterprise SaaS platform solution engineering is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with SDLC automation, Quality Engineering lifecycle, DevOps pipelines, and CI/CD best practices.



  





**Preferred / Nice to Have** 



* Experience building platforms that integrate with Jira, GitHub, or enterprise ALM toolchains.
* Contributions to open\-source AI/ML or agentic systems projects.
* Published solution frameworks or conference presentations in distributed systems or AI.

c9f5b1f9.title: Senior AWS Cloud & AI Architect
c9f5b1f9.description:
Job Title: Senior AWS Cloud \& AI Architect
   

  

 Experience: 10\+ Years
   

  

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

  

 Work Location: Chennai
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are looking for a highly technical and hands\-on Senior AWS Cloud \& AI Architect to lead AWS cloud architecture, infrastructure implementation, Generative AI adoption, and advanced technical troubleshooting.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in AWS architecture, Amazon Bedrock, Generative AI, RAG, Bedrock Agents, cloud security, networking, Windows application hosting, ECS containerization, CI/CD, and enterprise infrastructure operations.
   

  

 This role will also serve as a senior technical authority for complex infrastructure issues and will be responsible for leading technical interviews and assessments for Cloud, DevOps, and AI/ML engineering candidates.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Generative AI \& Amazon Bedrock Architecture
* Design and implement enterprise\-grade Generative AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock.
* Evaluate and select appropriate foundation models such as Claude, Llama, and other supported models.
* Implement prompt engineering, model orchestration, API integrations, and inference workflows.
* Design and implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases.
* Implement AI agents and automated workflows using Amazon Bedrock Agents.
* Configure and manage Bedrock Guardrails, model invocation logging, security controls, and data privacy mechanisms.
* Work with embeddings, vector databases, context\-window management, and semantic search.
* Integrate Bedrock with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and AWS services.
* Troubleshoot Bedrock throttling, latency, invocation failures, model integration, and AI pipeline issues.
* AWS Cloud Architecture \& Infrastructure
* Design highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient AWS cloud architectures.
* Architect solutions across multiple AWS services based on business and technical requirements.
* Design and implement AWS EC2 Auto Scaling environments for enterprise applications.
* Architect Windows\-based application hosting using Windows Server, IIS, AWS Systems Manager (SSM), FSx for Windows File Server, and Auto Scaling.
* Design containerized microservices using Amazon ECS, Fargate, EC2, and Amazon ECR.
* Optimize ECS tasks, services, deployments, networking, and auto\-scaling.
* Design serverless and event\-driven architectures using Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, and Step Functions.
* Design highly available database architectures using Amazon RDS, Aurora, and DynamoDB.
* Networking \& Security
* Design and troubleshoot complex AWS networking environments.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of VPC, subnets, route tables, security groups, NACLs, NAT Gateway, Internet Gateway, Route 53, CloudFront, ALB/NLB, Transit Gateway, and PrivateLink.
* Troubleshoot connectivity issues between AWS services, applications, containers, and on\-premises environments.
* Implement secure private connectivity to AWS services, including Amazon Bedrock through VPC/PrivateLink\-based architectures where applicable.
* Design enterprise security architectures using:
+ IAM
+ KMS
+ Secrets Manager
+ WAF
+ Shield
+ GuardDuty
+ AWS Config
+ CloudTrail

* Advanced Troubleshooting \& Operations
* Act as the highest\-level technical escalation point for complex AWS infrastructure and application issues.
* Perform root\-cause analysis across multiple AWS services and application layers.
* Troubleshoot:
+ EC2 and Windows Server issues
+ IIS application failures
+ ECS deployment and container issues
+ IAM permission problems
+ VPC and routing issues
+ Load balancer failures
+ DNS and Route 53 issues
+ AWS service connectivity issues
+ Bedrock throttling and latency
+ Application and infrastructure performance bottlenecks

* Analyze CloudWatch logs, CloudTrail events, application logs, network connectivity, and AWS service metrics.
* Drive incident resolution, problem management, and preventive improvements.
* Monitoring, Governance \& Infrastructure Management
* Implement monitoring and observability using Amazon CloudWatch and CloudTrail.
* Manage AWS infrastructure using AWS Systems Manager (SSM).
* Implement governance using AWS Organizations, Control Tower, AWS Config, and IAM.
* Design infrastructure automation using AWS CloudFormation and other Infrastructure\-as\-Code approaches.
* Implement scalable and automated infrastructure management across multiple AWS environments.
* DevOps \& CI/CD
* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for cloud infrastructure and applications.
* Integrate AWS environments with Azure DevOps and other DevOps tooling.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and application deployments.
* Work with CloudFormation, Git, CI/CD pipelines, container image management, and deployment automation.
* Establish DevOps best practices for AWS\-based applications and AI workloads.

 Software Architect — High\-Speed Interconnect Platforms
 







 Kandou AI is scaling fast, and we're looking for a Software Architect to help lead the software platform behind our next\-generation high\-speed interconnect technology.
 







 At Kandou, we build cutting\-edge, energy\-efficient chip\-to\-chip link solutions that power the infrastructure behind today's — and tomorrow's — data\-hungry world. If you're excited about working at the intersection of silicon, systems software, and hyperscale\-grade reliability, we want to talk to you.
 







 What You'll Own:
 



  





 Architect the software stack that sits above our device firmware — management interfaces, test\-orchestration tooling, telemetry pipelines, and customer\-facing SDKs.
 



 Design clean, stable APIs and adaptation layers that make customer integrations fast without forking the core codebase.
 



 Drive multi\-vendor interoperability validation with major hyperscale and cloud infrastructure players.
 



 Build out manufacturing test\-orchestration software, from test sequencing to yield analytics.
 



 Own DevOps and release engineering for the platform: CI/CD, build systems, hardware\-in\-loop automation, secure supply\-chain practices.
 



 Author rigorous architecture specifications and partner closely with firmware, ASIC design, product, and field engineering teams.
 



 Be a technical voice with customers on integration and escalation topics.
 



  





 What You Bring:
 



  





 8–10 years shipping software for high\-speed interconnect, module, or networking\-silicon products (not purely host\- or cloud\-side software).
 



 Hands\-on experience with industry management/interoperability standards for module\-based networking hardware.
 



 Strong background in sideband/management transports (I2C/SPI, MCTP, SMBus, I3C).
 



 Experience working directly with hyperscaler or tier\-one OEM customers on interoperability and qualification.
 



 Deep DevOps chops: CI/CD for multi\-target builds, conformance test harnesses, hardware\-in\-loop testing, Git\-based workflows.
 



 Strong C and Python skills, with a rigorous approach to testing (TDD, static analysis, automated regression).
 



 BS in EE, Comp Eng, or CS required; MS preferred.
 



 Why Kandou
 



 We're a passionate team of engineers pushing the boundaries of what's possible in high\-performance connectivity. We move fast, we solve hard problems, and we're building technology that's foundational to the next generation of computing infrastructure.
 







 Together We Kandou It.**

**Position Summary**
 We’re looking for a Cloud Infrastructure/Platform Engineer to build and operate a secure, scalable cloud “landing zone” and platform foundations. You’ll define and automate FinOps and Security governance using policy\-as\-code, create reusable infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) libraries, and enable teams through CI/CD pipelines and GitOps practices. You should bring deep hands\-on expertise in at least one major cloud (Azure or AWS preferred), with additional experience in GCP, OCI, or IBM Cloud as a plus.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and operate cloud landing zones (multi\-account/subscription, org structure, network, identity, logging, security baselines).
* Implement governance and guardrails using policy\-as\-code (e.g., Azure Policy, AWS Organizations/SCPs, OPA/Conftest), including exception handling and auditability.
* Define and deploy FinOps observability and enforcement tooling to enable DevOps teams to operate efficiently as well as cross\-account financial oversight.
* Deliver an infrastructure platform as a product to the internal development community.
* Develop reusable IaC modules/libraries (Terraform primary; Bicep/ARM and CloudFormation also valued) and promote standard patterns for teams.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure, OS Images, containers, and platform components using GitOps workflows (PR\-based changes, automated validation, progressive delivery).
* Standardize environments (dev/test/prod) with consistent controls, tagging/metadata, and cost management guardrails.
* Embed security and compliance into build/deploy: secret handling, encryption, IAM least privilege, vulnerability scanning, and evidence generation.
* Observability and SRE practices: implement monitoring/alerting and dashboards, support incident response, and help define/track SLIs/SLOs for platform services.
* Collaborate in an agile delivery model; participate in planning, refinement, and execution (SAFe experience is a bonus).


**Required Qualifications**
* Deep hands\-on experience engineering cloud infrastructure on one or more of Azure, AWS, and GCP (architecture \+ implementation).
* Strong proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform primary; Bicep/ARM and CloudFormation).
* Specific background in cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices, including Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, native cloud cost management tools, and policy\-based cost controls.
* Proven experience implementing landing zones / foundational cloud platforms (identity, network, shared services, governance).
* Experience with policy\-as\-code and automated compliance (e.g., Azure Policy, AWS Config \+ SCPs, OPA/Conftest).
* CI/CD expertise for infrastructure: pipeline design, testing/validation, approvals, environment promotion, drift detection.
* Working knowledge of configuration management/automation in current\-state enterprise environments (e.g., Ansible and Puppet).
* Strong understanding of IAM, network security, encryption, key management, and secure\-by\-default patterns.
* Comfortable with Git\-based workflows (PR reviews, branching strategies, versioning, release management).
* Scripting/programming ability (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go) to build automation and tooling.
* Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)
* Experience with Oracle Cloud (OCI)
* Experience with Cloud Financial Management (FinOps) and implementing FinOps policies using automation (“Policy as Code”)
* Strong Network Engineering background including cloud and hybrid\-cloud connectivity, network security policy automation, and cloud native network architectures.
* Experience working in hybrid environments to deliver platform automation solutions in the Data Center.
* Familiarity with security and control frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST 800\-171, SOX, SOC 2, and ISO 27002\.
* Kubernetes/platform experience (AKS/EKS/GKE/OKE), service mesh, or container platform operations.
* Experience with platform engineering concepts: developer portals/catalogs, golden paths, internal products.
* Familiarity with observability stacks: native CSP tooling, Datadog, Splunk, LogicMonitor
* SAFe or other structured agile delivery framework experience (PI planning, ARTs, epics/features).

e5e9ea4d.title: Delivery Manager - HCM
e5e9ea4d.description:
**About Darwinbox**
 Darwinbox is Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries. Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Airtel, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more. Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Delivery Assurance Manager to join our dynamic team and ensure that every Darwinbox Implementation delivers the desired transformational value to our enterprise users.
   

  

 The Delivery Assurance Manager serves as a key liaison between implementation teams, clients, and internal stakeholders, ensuring that all deliverables meet defined quality standards, timelines are adhered to, and client expectations are exceeded throughout the implementation lifecycle alongside ensuring their readiness to manage the system in the long run.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**Project Delivery Management**
* Oversee end\-to\-end Delivery Assurance for multiple concurrent Darwinbox Enterprise implementations across modules and geographies
* Ensure adherence to Darwinbox’s Implementation methodology ‘Inflexion’ and established best practices
* Drive timebound corrective actions via Client and Implementation Team leadership to ensure that the required resources with desired capabilities are available for the project.
* Serve as the strategic compass to ensure that Day 1 desired value is delivered on go\-live based upon the E3 methodology (Experience, Effectiveness and Efficiency).


**Quality Assurance and Risk Management**
* Identify potential risks, issues, and bottlenecks early and develop mitigation strategies
* Ensure that regular delivery checkpoints and quality reviews are carried out and corrective actions completed in time throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives based on lessons learned and improvements loop closed with client, implementation teams and other internal stakeholders.
* Steer Risk Management and Mitigation discussions during Steering Committee Meetings and leadership connections.


**Client Relationship Management**
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, providing expert guidance at every stage of the project and enabling the client to Champion the ‘Thriving in the Cloud’ approach.
* Handle escalations and work collaboratively with clients to resolve complex issues
* Drive client engagement initiatives and maintain strong relationships throughout the project duration
* Oversee Implementation Team to User handovers post\-implementation and ensure successful transition in conjunction with Darwinbox Customer Success Teams.


**Process Optimisation and Innovation**
* Design and refine delivery processes, methodologies, and documentation; maintain and progressively improve delivery templates, checklists, and knowledge repositories
* Analyze delivery metrics and provide insights for organizational improvement
* Stay current with HR technology trends and integrate innovative approaches into delivery practices
* Act as custodian of the Delivery Scorecard and corresponding actions for Implementations teams.
* Lead special projects focused on integrating AI tools into Delivery Assurance Processes.


**Qualifications**
* 10 years of experience in HRMS/SaaS implementation (HR domain preferred), with 4\+ years in Darwinbox/Workday/similar global HCM platforms deployments
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, IT, or related. MBA degree preferred (MBA, MS in Technology Management or equivalent)
* Certifications like Darwinbox, PMP, PRINCE2, Six Sigma or Agile/Scrum Master preferred
* Deep understanding of HR Business Processes across multiple modules: Core HR, Talent Development and Management, Employee Engagement, Payroll, leave, attendance and others.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Proficient in planning tools (JIRA, MS Projects or similar Project Management tools) and MS Office suite
* Familiarity with data migration, APIs, Excel/SQL/spreadsheets
* Strong project governance, risk mitigation, and multi\-stakeholder coordination capabilities
* Ability to prioritize, multitask, and drive projects under tight timeline

### **Description and Requirements**


Hybrid: \#LI\-Hybrid
BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry\-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
The Demo Centre of Excellence (Demo CoE) is responsible for designing, operating, maintaining, and continuously improving enterprise\-grade demonstration environments used by Sales Engineers, partners, and internal stakeholders worldwide.  

As a Sales Engineer in the Demo CoE team, the candidate will own the technical operations, administration, automation, governance, and enablement of demo platforms across SaaS, self\-hosted, cloud, and containerized environments. The role requires close collaboration with Sales Engineering, Product Development, Support, Cloud Operations, IT, and other stakeholders to ensure demo systems remain stable, secure, scalable, and aligned with the latest product capabilities.  

Key Responsibilities
**Demo Platform Management**
* Administer and maintain multiple production\-grade demo environments across SaaS and self\-hosted platforms.
* Ensure high availability, stability, resiliency, and performance of demo systems used for customer\-facing demonstrations.
* Manage infrastructure lifecycle activities including provisioning, configuration, upgrades, patching, migrations, and decommissioning.
* Support partner and internal demo environments across global regions.
  

**Cloud \& Infrastructure Administration**
* Manage resources across public cloud, private cloud, and containerized environments.
* Provision and maintain virtual machines, containers, Kubernetes/EKS resources, agents, plugins, and integrations.
* Drive cloud governance, housekeeping, resource optimization, and cost management initiatives.
* Monitor platform health and capacity to ensure optimal utilization of shared resources.
  

**Platform Operations \& Support**
* Troubleshoot complex platforms, infrastructure, networking, authentication, and application issues.
* Support Sales Engineers with demo preparation, environment access, configuration, and issue resolution.
* Install, configure, and maintain software components, agents, modules, plugins, and integrations.
* Act as an escalation point for demo\-environment\-related technical issues.
  

**DevOps, Automation \& GitHub Administration**
* Manage GitHub repositories, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and governance standards.
* Maintain GitHub as the single source of truth for demo platform assets, workflows, and configurations.
* Develop automation solutions that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Support Jobs\-as\-Code, automated deployments, workflow promotion, and environment standardization.
  

**Product Upgrades \& Innovation**
* Evaluate beta and GA releases of products and technologies.
* Plan and execute upgrades, patch deployments, and technology refreshes.
* Validate new features and integrations before broader adoption by the presale's organization.
* Research, prototype, and onboard emerging technologies, AI capabilities, and new integrations into demo environments.
  

**Documentation \& Enablement**
* Create and maintain technical documentation, deployment guides, operational procedures, and best practices.
* Deliver technical enablement sessions, workshops, and knowledge\-sharing activities.
* Support onboarding Sales Engineers and partners onto demo platforms.
* Promote governance, standards, and operational best practices.
* Stakeholder Collaboration
* Partner with Sales Engineers to support customer demonstrations and proof\-of\-concept activities.
* Collaborate with Product Management, R\&D, Cloud Operations, IT, and Support teams.
* Gather feedback from users and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Balance operational excellence with strategic innovation projects.
  

**Technical Skills**
* Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, or similar public cloud environments.
* Linux and Windows server administration.
* Kubernetes / Amazon EKS or equivalent container platform experience.
* GitHub administration, Git\-based workflows, and DevOps practices.
* CI/CD pipelines, automation, and Infrastructure as Code concepts.
* Monitoring platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, or equivalent observability tools.
* Networking, authentication, SSO, and role\-based access control concepts.
* Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.
* Enterprise software deployment, upgrade, and troubleshooting experience.
  

**Professional Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Customer\-focused mindset with a strong sense of ownership.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, globally distributed environment.
* Strong documentation and knowledge sharing discipline.
* Continuous learning attitude and willingness to work with new technologies.
* Cross\-functional collaboration and teamwork.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience may also be considered.
* Minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience in solution engineering, platform operations, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or enterprise software administration.
* Relevant cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Administrator/Architect, Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer, or equivalent are preferred.
* Kubernetes or Amazon EKS certifications, such as Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD), or AWS EKS\-focused credentials/training, are preferred.
  

  

CA\-DNP

BMC’s culture is built around its people. We have 6000\+ brilliant minds working together across the globe. You won’t be known just by your employee number, but for your true authentic self. BMC lets you be YOU!

  

  

If after reading the above, You’re unsure if you meet the qualifications of this role but are deeply excited about BMC and this team, we still encourage you to apply! We want to attract talents from diverse backgrounds and experience to ensure we face the world together with the best ideas!

**Demos \& proof of concept**

* 1–3 years of experience in IT presales, solution consulting, or a customer\-facing technical role

* Ability to quickly understand enterprise software products and articulate their value in business terms

4d29d6f4.description:
Shape the future with Delphi Consulting. We don't just hire talent we invest in people who are passionate about innovation, continuous learning, and creating meaningful impact. Join a team that's shaping the future of AI, data, cloud, and digital transformation while solving complex business challenges for leading enterprises. If you're ready to build what's next, your journey starts here.
 



  





**Role purpose** 




  





 The AI Solution Engineer is a senior, hands\-on member of the pre\-sales team responsible for shaping credible enterprise AI solutions and proving that they can work. The role combines technical discovery, architecture, prototyping, estimation and client presentation. The successful candidate must be able to move comfortably from an executive use\-case discussion to building and demonstrating a working solution on the Microsoft AI stack.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




  





 • Lead technical discovery with client business, data, security and technology stakeholders; convert business priorities into qualified AI use cases, solution requirements and a practical delivery approach.
 



 • Design secure, scalable enterprise architectures for generative AI, agentic AI, conversational AI, intelligent search, document intelligence and AI\-enabled applications using the Microsoft cloud stack.
 



 • Build working demonstrations, accelerators and proof\-of\-concepts using production\-relevant patterns not only mock\-ups to validate feasibility, user experience, integration and expected value.
 



 • Own the technical workstream of RFPs, RFIs and proposals, including architecture, solution narrative, scope, assumptions, dependencies, non\-functional requirements, effort estimates, bill of materials and delivery risks.
 



 • Define RAG, grounding, tool\-use, memory, orchestration, evaluation, observability and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns appropriate to each use case.
 



 • Assess model and platform choices across quality, latency, throughput, security, data residency, responsible AI and cost; explain the trade\-offs clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
 



 • Present solutions in workshops, solution reviews, demonstrations and bid presentations; respond credibly to detailed questions from enterprise architecture, cybersecurity and procurement teams.
 



 • Work with account, industry and delivery teams to shape opportunities, identify reusable assets and position differentiators without overcommitting scope or capability.
 



 • Support technical due diligence, implementation planning and handover after award, ensuring that proposal commitments are understood, feasible and traceable into delivery.
 



 • Maintain current knowledge of Microsoft AI services, reference architectures, licensing and emerging agentic patterns, and turn that knowledge into reusable pre\-sales assets.
 



  





**Required experience and capabilities** 




  





 • 7\+ years of professional experience across software engineering, cloud architecture, AI/ML engineering or enterprise solution consulting.
 



 • At least 3 years of hands\-on experience specifically designing and building generative AI solutions using large language models, including enterprise RAG and/or AI agents.
 



 • Demonstrable experience delivering AI or advanced analytics solutions beyond proof\-of\-concept stage, with a strong understanding of production engineering, security, monitoring and operational support.
 



 • Strong hands\-on development capability in Python and APIs/SDKs; experience with C\#/.NET is advantageous.
 



 • Deep understanding of LLM application patterns: prompt and context engineering, embeddings, vector and hybrid retrieval, tool/function calling, structured outputs, agent orchestration, evaluation and guardrails.
 



 • Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, document repositories and identity platforms.
 



 • Strong knowledge of cloud security, Entra ID, managed identities, private networking, secrets management, role\-based access control, data privacy and responsible AI controls.
 



 • Proven client\-facing experience in discovery, solution presentations, technical writing, estimation and proposal development for complex enterprise opportunities.
 



 • Ability to produce clear architecture diagrams, sequence flows, assumptions, sizing models and implementation plans under bid deadlines.
 



 • Excellent written and verbal English; able to challenge requirements constructively and communicate complex concepts without unnecessary jargon.
 



  





**Preferred qualifications** 




  





 • Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI\-103\), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\), or equivalent current Microsoft credentials.
 



 • Experience in regulated or government environments, including security review, data residency and private\-cloud/hybrid integration requirements.
 



 • Experience estimating Azure AI consumption, model throughput/capacity, search capacity, infrastructure and licensing for commercial proposals.
 



 • Experience creating reusable accelerators, reference architectures or demo environments for an AI consulting or technology pre\-sales organisation.

*Job Description*

**Inside Sales Executive – Zoho Solutions (Pre\-Sales \& Lead Qualification)**

**Department**

Sales

**Location**

Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Experience**

1–2 years

**Employment Type**

Full\-time

About the Role

Amwhiz is a Zoho implementation partner helping Tamil Nadu businesses go digital. We're hiring an Inside Sales Executive to own the first conversation with every new lead — understanding what the business actually needs, capturing the right information, and setting up our senior consultants for a focused, high\-value demo.

You won't be expected to be a Zoho expert on day one. We'll train you on a structured playbook that guides every call, so your job is to listen well, ask the right questions, and log the details accurately — not to know every Zoho product inside out.

What You'll Do

* Take the first call with every inbound lead (from ads, referrals, and website enquiries) within 24 hours of lead assignment.
* Run our structured discovery playbook to understand what the customer's business actually needs — not just what product they think they want.
* Ask the right qualifying questions to understand company size, current tools in use, urgency, and who the decision\-maker is.
* Accurately log every call's details into our CRM (HubSpot) — no lead should go un\-updated.
* Identify whether a lead needs a New Zoho Setup, help with an existing Zoho account, or a Support \& Fix, and route it correctly.
* Handle common early objections (like “I just want CRM”) using our scripted reframing approach, without being pushy.
* Schedule qualified leads for a demo/technical call with a senior consultant, and brief them beforehand.
* Follow up with leads who aren't ready yet, keeping them warm for future conversion.

What We're Looking For

* **1–2 years** of experience in inside sales, telesales, customer support, or lead qualification (software/SaaS background is a plus, not mandatory).
* **Fluent spoken and written English and Tamil** — mandatory.
* **Hindi speaking ability** — good to have.
* Comfortable making outbound calls and handling first\-time software buyers who may not be tech\-savvy.
* **Basic comfort using CRM tools/software** — full training provided on HubSpot.
* **A patient, consultative communication style** — someone who listens before pitching.
* **Organized and detail\-oriented** — this role lives and dies by accurate data capture.

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience in ERP, CRM, or SaaS sales/support.
* Familiarity with GST, Tally, or day\-to\-day operations of small businesses in Tamil Nadu.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Every assigned lead gets a completed discovery call within 24 hours.
* High accuracy in captured information — leads handed to seniors are genuinely qualified, not just “warm bodies.”
* Growing conversion rate from qualified lead → senior demo → closed deal.

Compensation \& Benefits

* **CTC:** Fixed \+ Performance Incentive, based on experience and interview performance.
* **Performance incentive tied to qualification quality and conversion** — not just call volume.
* Structured onboarding and ongoing training using AmWhiz's internal sales playbooks.
* Clear growth path toward Senior Sales / Zoho Consultant roles for strong performers.

Pay: ₹200,000\.00 \- ₹350,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

477dd21b.title: Solutions Development Architect
477dd21b.description:
Meet the Team
  
  

Security at Cisco is no longer a product you bolt on — it is table stakes, and it is a lifecycle, and our Customer Experience (CX) Professional Services team in Asia Pacific\& Japan is where that belief meets our largest Service Provider customers. We help Tier\-1 carriers, national operators, mobile network operators, and telco\-cloud/webscale providers across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN, and India transform their security architecture — infusing protection into the network fabric, embedding zero trust by design, and standing up a modern, AI\-driven Security Operations Center. We are a small, senior, high\-trust group of architects of record who operate at the intersection of deep networking and security, and who are trusted by CISOs and CTOs to set the security direction for some of the region's most complex networks. What is exciting is the scope: you own the security agenda for an entire vertical across four diverse markets, and you get to shape how an agentic, AI\-powered SOC and security\-by\-design come to life at carrier scale.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

As a senior Security Solutions Development Architect, you will drive the CX Security pre\-sales architecture and delivery strategy for highly complex, large\-scale groundbreaking engagements across APJ Service Provider accounts, acting as the security architect of record. You will influence security, network, and operations decisions at executive and C\-levels (CISO, CTO, SVP and above) and translate security architecture into measurable outcomes — risk reduction, faster mean\-time\-to\-detect/respond, lower threat dwell\-time, stronger compliance posture, and analyst productivity — so customers can see the business value, not just the technology. You will architect zero trust transformations and security\-by\-design controls (segmentation, secure connectivity, policy\-based isolation) that embed protection into routing, transport, data center, edge, and peering layers, then develop the observability framework and high\-fidelity detections that power an agentic, AI\-driven SOC. You will uncover new and expansion security opportunities, lead CX security RFI/RFP responses, and scope and price cross\-architecture proposals so they can be cleanly delivered by CX's technical delivery teams — staying lightly engaged post\-sale to ensure realization and bring together reference wins. Success looks like a growing, balanced CX Security business across APJ SP, with customers advancing along zero trust, security\-by\-design, and SOC\-modernization journeys that Cisco helped them design and deliver.
  
Security\& Service Provider Technical Domains
  
You are expected to bring architect\-level expertise across at least two domains — networking and security architecture — with cross\-domain fluency over the following:
  
  

* Zero Trust Architecture — zero trust design principles, identity and access, least\-privilege/segmented access, and assume\-breach patterns at SP scale.
* Security\-by\-Design\& Infrastructure Controls — segmentation/micro\-segmentation, secure connectivity, DDoS protection, secure firewalling, and SP edge/peering security embedded in the fabric.
* Networking Foundation — SP routing, transport, data center, and edge architectures as the substrate into which security is infused.
* Observability\& Telemetry Engineering — data collection, parsing, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and federated search across distributed, multi\-cloud data estates.
* Modern SOC\& Agentic Operations — high\-fidelity, actionable detection use cases, agentic investigation and response, advanced analytics, and SOC modernization.
* AI\-Driven Security — embedding AI and agentic capabilities across the security lifecycle to accelerate detection, investigation, and response.


APJ Regional Context
  
This role drives and grows the CX Security business across the APJ Service Provider vertical — operating across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam), and India — markets with varying security maturity and regulatory environments. You will account for the global nature of strategic SP customers while navigating multi\-country deployments, data sovereignty, in\-country data residency, and security/privacy compliance requirements specific to APJ, and partner with the regional SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to orchestrate large\-scale transformations. Preferred hiring locations: Indonesia, Malaysia, India.
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree \+ 12 years of related experience, OR Master's degree \+ 8 years, OR PhD \+ 5 years, OR equivalent relevant work experience.
* Deep networking expertise with demonstrated ability to apply zero trust security design principles (verify explicitly, least\-privilege access, assume breach) to transform customer security architectures at Service Provider scale.
* Shown mastery of security\-by\-design (network segmentation/micro\-segmentation and infrastructure controls) AND the design of observability frameworks and a modern SOC for detection and response (data collection, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, federated search, and high\-fidelity detection use cases).
* Practical AI fluency for security: demonstrated experience designing AI\-driven detection, investigation, and response and building high\-fidelity, agentic/automation\-led SOC workflows.
* Deep technical pre\-sales experience AND professional services/delivery experience, holding required certifications: CCNP Service Provider (or CCNP Enterprise/equivalent) AND CCNP Security (or equivalent) AND CISSP (or equivalent senior security architecture certification).


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Expert\-level certifications such as CCIE Service Provider, CCIE Enterprise, or CCIE Security; and/or security architecture frameworks such as SABSA or TOGAF.
* Zero trust / SOC and security\-analytics certifications (e.g., Splunk certifications, SANS/GIAC such as GCIH/GCDA), AI\-security credentials, and/or cloud\-security specializations (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Strong, fluent English (written and spoken) with the executive presence to influence at CISO/CTO/SVP\-and\-above level across diverse APJ markets.
* Recognized strategic influencer, comfortable shaping customer security vision and representing Cisco in industry forums and strategic alliances.
* Skilled at orchestrating the SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to deliver large\-scale, multi\-country Service Provider security transformations.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
