69541259.title: Solutions Architect
69541259.description:
**Solution Architect – Microsoft Business Applications** 




**Role Overview\-** 




 We are seeking a Solution Architect who can take business requirements and rapidly convert them into working solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem — Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and the underlying data and AI layer. This is a fast\-moving, hands\-on role: the person will not just design architecture on paper, but actively build and ship solutions. Equally important: this person must stay ahead of the Microsoft ecosystem on their own initiative — new product releases, AI capabilities, platform shifts — and proactively bring relevant innovations into Starlink and StarCent without being asked. We are not looking for someone who waits for direction; we're looking for someone who arrives with the direction already scoped out.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Translate business requirements directly into working solutions using Dynamics 365, Power Apps, and Power Automate — with a bias toward speed of solutioning, not just design documentation.
 



 • Own end\-to\-end delivery of automated workflows and low\-code applications that extend or fill gaps around D365\.
 



 • Architect how D365 and business data flows into Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory/Synapse, and how AI services (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI) can be layered on top to unlock new use cases.
 



 • Continuously track the Microsoft product roadmap and emerging AI capabilities — Copilot Studio, Azure AI, Power Platform updates — and proactively propose where these should be adopted internally, without waiting for a business ask.
 



 • Bring industry best practices into the organization unprompted; act as the internal expert who raises the bar rather than one who waits to be pushed.
 



 • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Business stakeholders to ensure solutions are grounded in real business outcomes, not just technical elegance.
 



 • Provide architectural guidance and hands\-on support to implementation teams — this role builds, not just advises.
 



 • Evaluate emerging Microsoft technologies and lead their adoption where there's a clear business case.
 



  





**Required Qualifications \& Experience (Must\-Haves)\-** 




  





 • 5\+ years hands\-on Solution Architecture experience within the Microsoft Dynamics 365 ecosystem. Deep, hands\-on expertise in:
 



 • Dynamics 365 (relevant modules — CE/F\&O/CS) • Power Apps — building and shipping custom low\-code applications
 



 • Power Automate — designing and deploying automated workflows as core infrastructure, not an afterthought
 



 • Demonstrated track record of converting business requirements into deployed solutions quickly — not just architecture diagrams.
 



 • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; able to work directly with business teams to scope requirements without heavy translation layers.
 



  





**Highly Valued (Good\-to\-Have — a candidate strong across all three is exceptional) \-** 




  





 • Microsoft Fabric — understanding how D365/business data lands, gets modeled, and becomes usable.
 



 • Azure Data Factory / Synapse — data integration and pipeline experience.
 



 • Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI Service — experience designing solutions that call into AI services from within business workflows. A candidate who combines strong Power Platform/D365 delivery skills with genuine Fabric \+ AI services experience is the ideal profile — this combination is rare and should be weighted heavily in evaluation.
 



  





**Ideal Candidate\-** 





 A self\-directed technologist who treats staying current on the Microsoft ecosystem as part of the job description, not an extracurricular. Someone who has already been the person in their last organization who said “we should be using this” before anyone asked — and who can prove it with a specific example, not just a claim. Combines fast, hands\-on solutioning with genuine curiosity about where Microsoft's AI and platform investments are heading next, and the judgment to know which of those are actually worth bringing into Starlink and StarCent.

**Positions \-**

**About The Company And The Product**
**India Health Link** 
 is building a new multi\-tenant Hospital Management Information System (HMIS) — one platform serving many hospitals — with Artificial Intelligence (AI) features delivered as optional plug\-ins on top of a core that works fully without them. It is a greenfield build, and the first pilot hospital goes live in month 6\.
   

  

**Our stack** 
 : Amazon Web Services (AWS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Docker, TypeScript and NestJS services, PostgreSQL 16, Python for the AI services.
   

  

**What You Will Build**
* The whole AWS footprint as Terraform code: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Elastic Container Service (ECS) Fargate, Relational Database Service (RDS) PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Simple Storage Service (S3\), OpenSearch, Redis, EventBridge and CloudFront.
* Continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) on GitHub Actions: build, test, migrate, deploy, roll back. Deployment must be boring.
* Environments: development, staging, pre\-production with anonymised data, and production.
* Monitoring and alerting that a twelve\-person team can actually respond to, with centralised logs and traces.
* Backup and disaster recovery with a tested restore, not a documented one.
* The on\-premise edge gateway image that runs inside a hospital's local network for analyser connectivity and Local Area Network mode when the internet is down.


**Responsibilities**
* Own infrastructure cost, keep it inside the agreed monthly budget, and report it monthly.
* Own security hygiene: least\-privilege identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, patching, and network boundaries.
* Own remediation for the Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Test (VAPT) in month 5 — coordinate the external firm and drive every finding to closure.
* Make the developer experience good. A new engineer should be productive on day two.
* Set up data\-residency arrangements appropriate to Indian health data.
* Be the person who can tell, at 2 am, whether the problem is our service, the database, or the hospital's internet connection.


**Requirements**
* Four or more years on AWS in production, including ECS or equivalent container orchestration, RDS, IAM and VPC networking.
* Terraform written and maintained by you, with proper modules and state management.
* Ownership of a CI/CD pipeline, including the database migration step.
* Observability in practice: you have been on call, and you have tuned alerts that were too noisy.
* Linux and networking fundamentals — you can debug why a device inside a hospital cannot reach a service.


**Good to have**
* Compliance work: ISO 27001, SOC 2, or Indian health data regulation.
* On\-premise or hybrid deployments, and hardware appliances in the field.
* Real cost optimisation on a live bill.
* Experience supporting customers with unreliable connectivity.


**Your first 90 days**
* Month 1 — all environments live, CI/CD running, the walking skeleton deployed automatically.
* Month 2 — monitoring, alerting and centralised logs in place; backups running with a tested restore.
* Month 3 — the edge gateway image built and running against analyser simulators.


**How We Work**
 Two\-week sprints. Everything is code — infrastructure included. Code review on every pull request.

* Experience creating infrastructure designs (e.g., telecom, electrical, mechanical), drawing sets for builds, and remodels of data center networking spaces.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience partnering with Data Science teams or directly leveraging machine learning and AI\-driven methodologies to scale forecasting models, automate anomaly detection, and simulate capacity scenarios.
* Experience in network capacity planning, demand forecasting, inventory optimization, or supply\-demand matching.
* Proficiency in data modeling, trend analysis, statistics, and data tools (e.g., SQL, spreadsheet software) to synthesize complex capacity metrics and performance loops.
* Strong foundational knowledge of network infrastructure concepts, including network routing, peering, cache infrastructure (CDN), or capacity placement.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 As a Network Capacity Planner, you will ensure Google Cloud’s growth by guaranteeing network capacity is delivered efficiently and on time to support products and customers. Operating across critical planning and execution horizons, you will blend a deep understanding of network fundamentals with machine learning and AI\-driven methodologies to scale forecasting, automate anomaly detection, and simulate complex capacity scenarios.
   

  

 Acting as a key technical collaborator alongside Technical Account Managers, Customer Engineers, and Product Managers, you will navigate customer requirements, mitigate supply stockouts, and manage inventory buffers. Your work will directly balance resource efficiency with high availability, safeguarding infrastructure performance and driving strategic demand attainment across the global network fleet.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Leverage deep knowledge of network fundamentals to understand critical paths, skillfully navigate complex customer requirements, and co\-develop tailored solutions alongside Technical Account Managers, Customer Engineers, and Product Managers.
* Own the execution window, capturing large agreement requirements and navigating network lead times.
* Build forecasting models leveraging machine learning and AI to improve predictive accuracy, automate anomaly detection, and simulate capacity scenarios.
* Mitigate supplies shortages, maintain optimal inventory levels, manage policy\-based buffers, and plan for major peak traffic events.
* Collaborate to build AI\-assisted automation for ordering and resource fulfillment while designing metrics to track fleet efficiency and demand attainment.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

* Manage expectations, resolve conflicts, and drive alignment across functions.

* Understand APIs, cloud platforms, system integrations, databases, and enterprise architecture.

**Delivery \& Governance**
* Drive program governance, planning, RAID management, dependency tracking, and release readiness.
* Monitor delivery milestones, risks, blockers, and resource planning.
* Lead steering committee meetings and executive status reviews.
* Ensure predictable and high\-quality execution.


**Business Ownership**
* Understand customer business problems instead of simply collecting requirements.
* Challenge unclear requirements and recommend better approaches.
* Balance technical feasibility with business priorities.
* Drive adoption and business outcomes after implementation.

* Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
* Experience managing enterprise software implementation programs.
* Strong stakeholder management across Engineering, Product, QA, Business, and Customers.
* Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
* Strong risk management, dependency management, and release planning experience.
* Ability to influence senior leadership across multiple functions.
* Comfortable working in fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environments.


**Technical Knowledge**
**Good Understanding Of**
* Cloud Platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* APIs \& System Integrations
* Databases
* Enterprise Applications
* Agile / Scrum
* JIRA / Confluence
* Release Management
* DevOps concepts
* Software Architecture fundamentals


**Preferred Background**
* Services company experience is highly preferred.
* Experience managing enterprise software implementations.
* Experience in Retail, Insurance, BFSI, or Digital Transformation programs is a strong advantage.
* Candidates who started their career as Software Developers and transitioned into Program Management are highly preferred.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams is desirable.


**What We're Looking For**
 We are looking for someone who:
   

  

* Owns delivery end\-to\-end rather than simply coordinating tasks.
* Can confidently interact with CXOs and senior customer stakeholders.

* Can challenge requirements when necessary.

* Is technically sound enough to earn the respect of engineering teams while keeping business objectives at the center of every decision.

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in cyber security technologies, excellent presentation abilities, and hands\-on experience in solution design and customer engagement.

* Engage with customers to understand their security infrastructure, business requirements, and technical challenges.
* Design and propose end\-to\-end cyber security solutions tailored to customer environments.
* Deliver technical presentations, product demonstrations, workshops, and executive briefings.
* Conduct Proof of Concepts (POCs), solution validations, and technical assessments.
* Prepare technical proposals, Statements of Work (SOW), Bill of Materials (BOM), and RFP/RFI responses.
* Collaborate with sales teams to develop winning technical strategies for customer opportunities.
* Provide technical consultation on security best practices, compliance requirements, and risk mitigation.
* Work closely with OEMs, distributors, and internal engineering teams for solution positioning and implementation planning.
* Stay updated with emerging cyber threats, market trends, and latest security technologies.
* Support post\-sales transition by ensuring smooth handover to implementation and support teams.

* Vulnerability Assessment \& Penetration Testing (VAPT)
* Network Security

* Endpoint Detection \& Response (EDR/XDR)
* SIEM \& SOC Solutions
* Email Security
* Identity \& Access Management (IAM)
* Cloud Security
* Zero Trust Architecture
* Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
* Web Application Firewall (WAF)
* VPN, Routing \& Switching

Experience with technologies and solutions from:

* Palo Alto Networks
* Fortinet
* Cisco
* Sophos
* CrowdStrike
* Microsoft Security
* Check Point Software Technologies
* Trend Micro

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or related field.
* Relevant certifications preferred:
* CEH
* CISSP
* Security\+
* CCNA / CCNP Security
* NSE Certification
* Palo Alto Certifications
* Microsoft Security Certifications

Required Skills

* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Excellent customer handling and consulting abilities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with sales and technical teams.
* Experience in enterprise customer engagement is preferred.

Preferred Experience

* Experience working with System Integrators (SI), Value Added Resellers (VAR), or Managed Security Service Providers (MSSP).
* Exposure to enterprise and government security projects.
* Experience handling large\-scale cyber security deployments and tenders.

Compensation \& Benefits

* Competitive salary package
* Performance incentives
* Career advancement opportunities

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹70,000\.00 per month

Description
We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect who can own end\-to\-end solution architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Marketing Cloud, and guide broader multi\-cloud engagements. The candidate should have strong conceptual and working knowledge of Apex and LWC to review and guide development, the ability to advise on Salesforce's AI capabilities, and the certifications typically expected at this level of experience.


Responsibilities
* Own end\-to\-end Salesforce solution architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and other clouds as engagements require
* Lead architecture and solution design workshops; prepare technical design documents and define best\-practice architecture
* Advise on and design AI\-driven capabilities (Agentforce, Einstein AI, Data Cloud) into the overall solution
* Own data architecture, integration strategy, security model, and governance across the platform
* Review and guide Apex/LWC development work; ensure code quality and architectural alignment
* Manage third\-party integrations and multi\-cloud data flow
* Conduct architecture reviews, gap analysis, and platform health checks for existing implementations
* Mentor Consultants/Developers on architecture best practices
* Stay current with new Salesforce releases, features, and AI capabilities, and recommend adoption where relevant

**Salesforce Clouds**

* Sales Cloud — Lead/Opportunity management, forecasting, CPQ basics (Must Have)
* Service Cloud — Case management, Omni\-Channel (Must Have)
* Marketing Cloud — Journey Builder, Email Studio, Automation Studio (B2C marketing) (Must Have)
* Marketing Cloud Account Engagement / Pardot — B2B marketing automation (distinct product from Marketing Cloud) (Good to Have)
* Experience Cloud (Community Cloud) — Partner/Customer portals (Good to Have)
* Data Cloud — Unified customer data, segmentation (Good to Have)
* Revenue Cloud / CPQ \& Billing — Quote\-to\-cash processes (Good to Have)
* Health Cloud / Financial Services Cloud — for industry\-specific engagements (Good to Have)
* Analytics / Tableau / CRM Analytics — Reporting and business intelligence (Good to Have)

**AI Modules**

* Agentforce — AI agent configuration for sales/service processes (Good to Have)
* Einstein AI (Copilot, GPT, Prediction Builder, Bots) — predictive and generative AI features (Good to Have)
* Prompt Builder — AI prompt template design (Good to Have)
Required Skills
* Strong conceptual and working knowledge of Apex — enough to review, guide, and unblock the development team (hands\-on coding not mandatory at this level)
* Strong conceptual and working knowledge of Lightning Web Components (LWC) and modern Salesforce UI architecture
* Deep understanding of Salesforce data model, security architecture, and integration patterns (REST/SOAP, MuleSoft preferred)

**Certifications**

* AI Associate / Agentforce Specialist — exposure to Salesforce AI capabilities (Good to Have)

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field

DevOps Architect — India


Location: India (Hybrid/Remote, overlap hours with US\-based Architect(s) and Delivery Lead)


Experience: 10\+ years overall, 6\+ years in DevOps/infrastructure architecture


Role Summary


The DevOps Architect owns CI/CD, environment, release, and infrastructure architecture across the account's delivery pods, ensuring every workstream can build, test, and ship reliably regardless of which technology stack is ultimately selected. This role designs the automation and quality gates that both human engineers and AI coding agents build against, and is accountable for the pipeline and infrastructure practices that keep an agent\-orchestrated development model safe and predictable in production.


Key Responsibilities


* Own CI/CD pipeline architecture, branching strategy, and release automation across all workstreams, repeatable per delivery pod.
* Own environment strategy: provisioning, configuration management, and refresh cadence for development, test, and staging environments across workstreams.
* Design automated quality gates (build, test, static analysis, security scanning) that apply consistently to both human\-written and AI\-agent\-generated code before it merges or deploys.
* Own infrastructure architecture, including cloud resource design, monitoring, logging, alerting, and reliability/SRE practices.
* Partner with the Principal Architect(s) to ensure DevOps and infrastructure decisions align with the overall solution architecture, once the technology stack is confirmed.
* Own release management practices — versioning, rollback procedures, deployment windows — sized to support the delivery cadence of an agent\-orchestrated build workflow.
* Direct and prompt AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code or equivalent) for infrastructure\-as\-code, pipeline configuration, and automation scripting, then review and harden the output.
* Own incident response and root\-cause analysis processes for production issues, driving remediation and preventive fixes.
* Own security and compliance practices for infrastructure — secrets management, access controls, and audit logging — in coordination with the client's security team.
* Evaluate and integrate new CI/CD, infrastructure, and AI/agentic tooling into the delivery model.
* Set and enforce DevOps standards and mentor DevOps engineers embedded within each workstream's delivery pod.

Required Qualifications


* 10\+ years in enterprise technology roles with 6\+ years specifically in DevOps or infrastructure architecture.
* Deep expertise in CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar) and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
* Strong background in cloud platform architecture (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and monitoring/observability tooling.
* Experience designing environment and branching strategies for multi\-workstream delivery programs.
* Technology\-agnostic release management experience — comfortable integrating CI/CD with either platform\-specific deployment tooling (e.g., Salesforce release tools such as Copado/Gearset) or standard web\-application deployment pipelines, depending on final stack selection.
* Hands\-on experience directing or prompting AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code or an equivalent agentic development tool) — required, as this engagement uses an agent\-orchestrated development model.
* Security\-conscious approach to infrastructure design: secrets management, access control, and compliance awareness.

Preferred Qualifications


* Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS/Azure/GCP DevOps Engineer or Solutions Architect, Terraform Associate).
* Experience setting up quality gates or guardrails specifically for AI\-agent\-generated code.
* Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) background.

0569ac63.description:
About This Role
**13 to 18 years of experience**  

**Skills: Principal Architect**

**Principal Architect**
=======================


**Location:** India (Hybrid, overlap hours with US delivery leadership)


**Experience:** 13\+ years overall, 8\+ years in architecture/technical leadership roles


**Role Summary**
----------------


The India\-based Principal Architect owns technical execution architecture across the offshore delivery organization, translating the program's approved solution architecture (set by the US Principal Architect) into stream\-level technical designs, engineering standards, and build\-readiness across every functional track. This is an execution and engineering\-governance leadership role, not a client\-facing architecture\-ownership role.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Own the technical build architecture for each functional stream, converting the approved solution architecture into implementable technical designs for the Solution Architect and engineering pods — independent of the final technology stack selected.


* Enforce engineering\-wide standards for coding, design patterns, integration approaches, and CI/CD across all India\-based development teams.


* Lead technical design reviews for stream\-level solutions before they proceed to build, ensuring consistency with the platform's global data model and security model.


* Direct and prompt AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code or equivalent) for architecture spikes, technical validation, and build\-readiness proofs before handing designs to engineering.


* Own resolution of stream\-level technical defects and integration issues identified during SIT/UAT, coordinating fixes across engineering teams.


* Manage technical dependency sequencing across streams so cross\-stream build work lands in the right order.


* Mentor and provide technical escalation support to the Solution Architect and Mid\-Senior Engineers; act as the final internal review gate before designs are presented to the US Principal Architect.


* Own environment strategy execution (sandbox/environment seeding, data refresh cadence, release branching) in coordination with the India Senior Project Manager's release calendar.


* Track engineering\-level technical debt and raise remediation proposals through the architecture chain rather than directly to the client.


* Evaluate and integrate new tools, frameworks, and AI/agentic development capabilities into the engineering workflow.


**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* 13\+ years in enterprise technology roles with 8\+ years in an architecture or senior technical leadership capacity.


* Proven ability to translate approved solution architecture into implementable technical designs across multiple concurrent workstreams, independent of a specific technology stack.


* Deep, current hands\-on fluency in modern software architecture, integration design, and DevOps tooling — technology\-agnostic, able to work confidently across CRM platforms or full\-stack web stacks depending on final selection.


* Hands\-on experience directing or prompting AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code or an equivalent agentic development tool) as part of an agent\-orchestrated delivery model — required.


* Experience leading distributed engineering teams (multiple pods/streams) through technical design, build, and defect resolution.


* Demonstrated experience operating as the internal technical authority reporting into a senior/principal architect rather than directly into the client.


**Good To Have**
----------------


* Enterprise or cloud architecture certification (e.g., TOGAF, or a platform\-specific architect certification depending on final stack).


* Experience in pharma, healthcare distribution, or another regulated industry. Experience managing technical debt and governance across offshore\-led delivery models.

add76d6a.title: Finance solution Architect S/4 Hana Public cloud | EMEA | India
add76d6a.description:
**Company Description** **Colliers (NASDAQ, TSX: CIGI) is a global diversified professional services and investment management company. Operating through three industry\-leading platforms – Real Estate Services, Engineering, and Investment Management – we have a proven business model, an enterprising culture, and a unique partnership philosophy that drives growth and value creation. For 30 years, Colliers has consistently delivered approximately 20% compound annual returns for shareholders, fuelled by visionary leadership, significant inside ownership and substantial recurring earnings. With $5\.5 billion in annual revenues, a team of 24,000 professionals, and \*$108 billion in assets under management, Colliers remains committed to accelerating the success of our clients, investors, and people worldwide. Learn more at corporate.colliers.com, X @Colliers or LinkedIn.**

 **Job Description**  

The EMEA SAP Solution Architect will support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of Colliers' SAP technology landscape, with a primary focus on SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.


Working as part of the EMEA Technology Solutions team, the role is responsible for translating business requirements into scalable, supportable technical solutions, ensuring applications are configured and integrated effectively whilst supporting the ongoing evolution of the Finance Systems platform.


The role will work closely with the Product Manager, Business Analysts, Finance stakeholders, delivery partners and third\-party suppliers to deliver new functionality, improve business processes and maintain a stable, secure production environment across the EMEA region.


This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced SAP Consultant or Technical Lead looking to progress into a Solution Architect role.

**Purpose of the Role**


The SAP Solution Architect will support the SAP Platform Architect in delivering the Finance Systems roadmap whilst ensuring SAP solutions remain aligned to business priorities, enterprise architecture standards and operational support requirements.


The role will contribute to solution design, application configuration, integration design and continuous improvement activities, whilst helping to ensure the Finance platforms remain secure, reliable and fit for future business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Design**

* Design scalable, supportable SAP solutions across SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, with awareness of related platforms such as SAP Analytics Cloud, CIM and SAP Concur.
* Produce solution designs and technical documentation that align with enterprise architecture standards.
* Support solution assurance throughout project delivery.
* Ensure new solutions are maintainable, secure and operationally supportable.

 **SAP Configuration \& Technical Support**

* Support the configuration and enhancement of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, working with related applications where required.
* Provide technical guidance to Functional Analysts and delivery partners.
* Support complex production issues and third\-line investigations where required.
* Assist with SAP release planning, upgrades and regression testing.

 **Integration**

* Design and support integrations between SAP Finance applications and other enterprise systems.
* Work alongside integration specialists to deliver secure and reliable interfaces.
* Support troubleshooting of integration issues and identify opportunities to improve performance and resilience.
* Ensure appropriate documentation is maintained for integrations and technical designs.

 **Product \& Change Delivery**

* Support the Platform Manager in delivering the Finance Systems roadmap.
* Contribute to backlog refinement, solution estimation and technical planning.
* Work with Business Analysts to translate business requirements into solution designs.
* Support the successful delivery of projects, enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives.

 **Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build effective relationships with Finance, Technology and third\-party suppliers.
* Participate in workshops with business stakeholders to understand requirements.
* Explain technical solutions in business\-friendly language.
* Work collaboratively across Architecture, Infrastructure, Security and Service Management teams.

 **Service Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve system performance, usability and operational support.
* Contribute to root cause analysis for recurring issues.
* Support the development of standards, documentation and best practice.
* Promote standard SAP functionality wherever appropriate.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or related discipline (or equivalent experience).


SAP certifications in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, SAC, CIM or Concur would be advantageous but are not essential

 **Additional Information*** **Skills \& Experience**

**Essential**
* Hands\-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud is essential.
* Professional Services and Project systems knowledge is highly desirable
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud extensibility, including Custom Fields, Custom Logic, Projects and Queries, and CDS views.
* Strong understanding of SAP processes and how they are delivered in a public cloud environment.
* Experience participating in SAP implementation or support projects.
* Understanding of SAP integrations and APIs.
* Knowledge of IT Service Management processes.
* Experience working with third\-party support providers.
* **Desirable**
* Experience or working exposure with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), CIM and SAP Concur would be advantageous.
* Knowledge of the Professional Services line of business and project\-based processes would be desirable.
* Understanding of SAP Fiori.
* Knowledge of SAP security concepts.
* Experience working within an Agile delivery environment.
* Exposure to SAP licensing and release management.

Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team


NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It’s a place where passionate individuals come together to create the future of sport. We are unapologetic about who we are and what we’re after—bringing innovation and inspiration to every athlete\* in the world. We look for athletes who can push boundaries, elevate our potential and continue leading us to greatness. The next tastemakers, playmakers, risk takers and glue players. Are you game?


**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**
------------------------


You will be part of the Supply Chain \& Planning Technology (SCPT) Portfolio \& Operations team, helping establish and mature SCPT’s operational footprint in Nike’s India Technology Center (ITC). You will report to the Director, SCPT ITC Operations and work in close partnership with Domain Portfolio \& Operations Leaders to facilitate delivery within the Sub\-Domain you support. You will collaborate directly with Product and Engineering leaders, Program Operations peers, Portfolio team and Initiative Program Managers, across locations in India, the US, and Europe.


**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**
--------------------------


We are looking for a hands\-on operator with experience in a scaled environment who can help teams predictably plan, execute and continuously improve how work gets done.


The right person brings strong program operations discipline, practical agile delivery experience, and the ability to turn data and metrics into clear insights that help leaders make informed decisions. They are comfortable partnering in a matrixed environment, influencing through trust and clarity, and improving operating standards without adding unnecessary process.


* 7\+ years of experience in program operations, technical program management, delivery operations, agile delivery, or a related technology operations role.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant field, or equivalent combination of education, experience, and training.
* Demonstrated experience supporting agile teams and delivery practices, including practical use of tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Experience creating dashboards, reports, and communicating operating insights that provide transparency into team health, progress, risks, and delivery effectiveness.
* Strong facilitation skills, including experience supporting planning rhythms such as quarterly planning, retrospectives, and operational readouts.
* Proven ability to partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations leaders to identify friction, clarify accountability, and improve ways of working.
* Comfort operating across geographies, cultures, and time zones, with a collaborative style that builds connection and alignment across distributed teams.
* Curiosity and practical experience using automation or AI\-enabled tools to simplify work, improve consistency, and scale operational practices.
* Preferred: experience with supply chain and/or planning technology delivery.

**WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON**
-----------------------


You will champion delivery excellence across Supply Chain \& Planning Technology by driving consistent operating standards, delivery frameworks, and execution practices. Your work will provide clear visibility into team health, program execution, and operational effectiveness so leaders and teams can make better decisions, address risks sooner, and continuously improve how teams deliver.


**Sub\-Domain Delivery Partnership —** Operate in close partnership through a dotted line relationship with the Domain Portfolio \& Operations Leader to facilitate delivery within the sub\-domain and help translate operating standards into practical execution.


**Agile Tools and Standards —** Drive consistent use of agile tools, program standards, and delivery practices, including Jira, Confluence, and related operating mechanisms.


**Quarterly Planning Readiness —** Support the quarterly planning process and facilitation by ensuring teams are prepared, aligned, and set up for successful execution.


**Dashboards, Reporting, and Insights —** Create and maintain dashboards and reporting that provide transparency into team performance, progress, and risks; use insights to highlight gaps and drive improvements.


**Operational Improvement —** Actively surface inefficiencies or gaps in squad operations and work with teams to implement practical improvements that increase delivery effectiveness and predictability.


**Change Management —** Lead adoption and change management of new tools, processes, and ways of working so teams understand what is changing, why it matters, and how to apply it.


**Product and Engineering Partnership —** Co\-create and collaborate with Product and Engineering partners to evolve squad operating standards and agile ways of working.


**AI\-Enabled Ways of Working —** Identify and drive operational and process improvements that increase efficiency, consistency, and effectiveness across SCPT, using AI\-enabled tools to experiment, learn, and scale what works.


**Program Delivery Support —** Support program delivery within the sub\-domain on an ad\-hoc basis in alignment with the Domain Portfolio \& Operations Leader.


**Initiative Program Partnership —** Partner with Initiative Program Managers, where applicable, to facilitate delivery and support program objectives.


**Local Execution for Cross\-Domain Work —** Drive and support local execution of cross\-domain or SCPT\-wide programs during local business hours.


NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete\* in the world.


NIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

  
* 
* 
What You Can Expect
**OUR HIRING GAME PLAN**
------------------------


### **01 Apply**


Our teams are made up of diverse skillsets, knowledge bases, inputs, ideas and backgrounds. We want you to find your fit – review job descriptions, departments and teams to discover the role for you.


### **02 Meet a Recruiter or Take an Assessment**


If selected for a corporate role, a recruiter will reach out to start your interview process and be your main contact throughout the process. For retail roles, you’ll complete an interactive assessment that includes a chat and quizzes and takes about 10\-20 minutes to complete. No matter the role, we want to learn about you – the whole you – so don’t shy away from how you approach world\-class service and what makes you unique.


### **03 Interview**


Go into this stage confident by doing your research, understanding what we are looking for and being prepared for questions that are set up to learn more about you, and your background.

About This Role
**10 years of experience**  

**Skills: Solution Architecture, Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, GenAI, LLMs, RAG, React.js / Angular, AWS / Azure / GCP, System Design, Enterprise Solutioning, Domain\-Driven Design, Client Communication, Stakeholder Engagement**

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for a highly accomplished Solution Architect with 10\+ years of experience. You will lead the architecture and solutioning of complex, enterprise\-grade technology programmes for our clients; spanning Java\-based backend systems, modern frontend applications, microservices platforms, and cutting\-edge GenAI solutions.


This role demands not just technical depth but exceptional communication and client engagement skills. You will regularly interface with C\-suite executives, enterprise architects, and business leaders — translating complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives and actionable solution strategies. You will be the face of our technical practice to clients, and your ability to listen, articulate, influence, and inspire confidence will be as critical as your architecture expertise.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Lead end\-to\-end enterprise solution architecture — defining architectural vision, patterns, and standards across Java backend, frontend, microservices, and GenAI technology layers.
* Produce comprehensive architecture artefacts — solution designs, architecture decision records (ADRs), high\-level and low\-level design documents, data flow diagrams, and technical roadmaps.
* Architect and govern microservices\-based platforms — defining service decomposition strategies, API contracts, event\-driven communication patterns, and service mesh configurations.
* Design and integrate GenAI and LLM\-powered capabilities — including RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and AI\-augmented features — into enterprise product architectures responsibly and at scale.
* Provide architectural oversight across frontend implementation — governing micro\-frontend strategies, component design systems, and API integration patterns using React.js, Angular, or equivalent.
* Lead enterprise product solutioning — conducting build vs buy analysis, vendor evaluation, technology selection, and total cost of ownership assessments aligned with business objectives.
* Define and enforce non\-functional requirements — scalability, resilience, performance, security, and compliance — across all solution designs and technical deliverables.
* Engage and present to senior stakeholders, including C\-suite, executive sponsors, and Architecture Review Boards — communicating complex technical concepts with clarity, confidence, and business relevance.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering Leads, Product Managers, Data Architects, DevOps teams, and Business Analysts to ensure architectural intent is understood and faithfully implemented.
* Champion cloud\-native architecture principles — designing solutions on AWS and / or Azure using infrastructure\-as\-code, containerisation, and serverless patterns.
* Establish and evolve architecture governance frameworks, review processes, and technical standards across the engineering organisation.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies — GenAI, AI agents, edge computing, and platform engineering — to continuously advance the organisation's technology capability.
* Mentor and guide senior engineers and technical leads, growing architectural thinking and design capability across the engineering community.
* Support pre\-sales, RFP responses, and client\-facing solutioning activities where required.

**What We're Looking For**


* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering and solutions architecture, with a demonstrable track record of leading enterprise\-scale product solutioning from concept to delivery.


* Deep expertise in Java / Spring Boot and designing production\-grade, cloud\-native microservices architectures at scale.


* Proven experience architecting and delivering GenAI / LLM\-powered solutions — including RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and responsible AI implementation.


* Strong architectural knowledge across frontend technologies — React.js, Angular, or equivalent — with the ability to govern frontend architecture and micro\-frontend patterns.


* Solid cloud architecture experience on AWS and / or Azure — designing scalable, secure, and cost\-optimised cloud\-native solutions.


* Expertise in system design fundamentals — distributed systems, event\-driven architecture, API\-first design, Domain\-Driven Design, and CQRS / Event Sourcing.


* Strong experience with enterprise product solutioning — requirements analysis, technology selection, vendor assessment, and architecture roadmap development.


* Exceptional communication and presentation skills — proven ability to engage, influence, and align C\-suite executives, senior stakeholders, and cross\-functional delivery teams.


* Experience contributing to or leading Architecture Review Boards (ARBs) and governance processes across large technology organisations.


* Strong understanding of security architecture — OAuth2, Zero Trust, IAM — and regulatory compliance frameworks including GDPR.


* Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers and instil architectural thinking and engineering excellence across delivery teams.


**Nice to Have**


* TOGAF 9 / 10 certification or equivalent enterprise architecture framework knowledge.
* Experience with multi\-cloud or hybrid cloud architecture strategies.
* Exposure to platform engineering and internal developer platform (IDP) design.
* Familiarity with graph databases (Neo4j, Neptune) for knowledge graph and Graph RAG use cases.
* Experience with edge AI, model compression, or on\-device AI deployment.
* Pre\-sales or client\-facing solutioning experience in a consulting or product organisation.
* AWS Solutions Architect Professional / Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification.
* Experience delivering architecture in regulated industries — Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare, or equivalent.
* Knowledge of FinOps principles and cloud cost governance frameworks.

Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
   

  

 During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
   

  

**About the Role**
 We're looking for a Staff Program Manager for our Engineering Operations team to help us reach our goals and make our Engineering team the best it can be!
   

  

 The mission for the Staff Program Manager, Engineering Operations, is to maintain and accelerate the highest level of execution excellence of Fivetran engineering. Our Engineering organization comprises several global functional groups that use a range of processes, systems, tools, and KPIs to jointly deliver best\-in\-class data pipelines and drive innovation.
   

  

 The role focuses on increasing the efficiency and effectiveness of one or more of our Engineering functions in delivering our strategic objectives by streamlining engineering processes and leading major initiatives, such as process and efficiency improvement projects \& programs.
   

  

 As the majority of the processes are in the software development industry, the role assumes you have broad experience in software development and have led multiple programs that shipped software from start to finish. You have worked closely with cross\-functional teams with design, research, product, and engineering. Preferably, you work at a tech company and are heavily involved in engineering operations, with a deep understanding of how engineering processes work under the hood and how to take them to the next level.
   

  

 We want you to bring your passion for problem\-solving, experience in the tech world, and the drive to help us get to the next level, and have some fun along the way.
   

  

 This is a full\-time position based out of our Bengaluru office.
   

  

**Technologies You'll Use**

**What You'll Do**

* Oversee operations for your respective global group, with a particular focus on increasing efficiency, stability, and effectiveness in delivering their strategic objectives.
* Act as a strategic partner for the global group leader regarding short and long\-term vision, planning (quarterly and annual), and execution, as well as establishing and tracking engineering OKRs and KPIs. All this with consistent alignment with engineering\-wide policies and practices.
* Maintain the engineering process library and improve it in collaboration with process owners, other operations managers, the PMO, engineering leadership, and leadership of partnering departments such as Product, Analytics, and Design.
* Lead and manage process and efficiency improvement programs aiming to set up or improve engineering and cross\-departmental processes, from problem definition and data analysis through solution proposal, stakeholder alignment, and execution — resulting in documented, repeatable, and measurable processes.
* Collaborate and openly debate with the team of operations managers to manage engineering initiatives, solve problems, discuss challenges, and learn more about critical issues as a group of Engineering Operations.
* Work with Engineering teams to ensure adherence to operational processes, conduct process audits and check\-ins, and discuss opportunities for improvement with senior engineers and engineering leadership, identifying opportunities to optimize and automate routine operations.
* Provide leadership, improvement, and support of our internal knowledge management process and information structure in collaboration with PMO, technical enablement teams, and technical writers.
* Support the coordination, preparation, and delivery of company\-wide engineering updates and events.
* Act as a role model and a champion for operational excellence, project management practices, risk management, and security practices.


**Skills We're Looking For**
* 10\+ years of experience in technical/operations management in the technology/software development industry.
* Ability to work directly with senior leadership on strategic programs, including leading cross\-functional R\&D initiatives from start to finish.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity, working independently, and problem\-solving within fast\-paced and constantly changing environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills with the ability to interact and collaborate with technical and non\-technical groups at all levels.
* A data\-driven and action\-oriented mindset with excellent planning, analytical, problem\-solving, project/program management, organizational, and leadership skills.
* Ability to identify and meet with key players and stakeholders to shape consensus collectively and engage in dialogue to reach a conclusion, compromising as necessary for results.
* You are fearless, goal\-focused, and pragmatic, and you understand the complexity of working with a multitude of different teams and people.
* You are recognized as a go\-to expert in one or more engineering operations domains (e.g., System Design, Data Architecture, Infrastructure Management, including cost management, Quality) and use that expertise to drive innovation in how your global group approaches them \- not just facilitate conversations, but shape and influence the technical direction of SDLC and process decisions.
* Stays current on industry trends and business developments relevant to engineering operations, and applies that context to inform recommendations and decisions.
* Ability to leverage AI to increase your own productivity and leverage it in the solutions you're building.


**(Optional)Bonus Skills**
* Experience driving projects end\-to\-end, and shipping complex, large\-scale software projects with global teams utilizing different SDLCs.
* Familiarity with project management tools like Jira, knowledge management tools like Notion, and analytical tools like Looker and Sigma.
* Experience working with cloud platforms and SaaS companies is a plus.

**Dear Aspirant!**
 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.
   

  

**We are looking for: Electrical Engineer (For Preparing Medium Voltage AIS Switchgear Proposal)**
**You’ll Make An Impact By**
* Review of Customer specifications, commercial/technical documents, product requirements.
* Identify and define preliminary scope of work for Switchgear and its associated components that fit the Customer specifications.
* Identify and define preliminary scope of work for E\-houses, transformers, Battery System, UPS and its associated components that fits the Customer specifications.
* From the customer RFQ Understand the commercial terms / commercial requirements such as payment terms, cancellation schedule etc.
* Prepare Bills of Materials, Layout Drawings, Single line Drawings and Specification Review documents based on the best judgement of the Engineer.
* Collaborate with Engineers within the Business Unit to generate technical solutions for the Siemens suite of products.
* Prepare RFQ packages for third party products such as Battery System, UPS etc and work closely with Procurement team to secure the quotations.
* Perform quote evaluations of all the quotations received and make technical recommendations to the design and the vendor choices.
* Develop the cost model for the quotation using product configurator tools and secure approvals from the senior management.
* Prepare Customer\-facing proposal packages for the complete scope of work.
* Engaging in Customer discussions by supporting the Business Development and Sales teams.
* Work closely with the PMO team for an efficient and effective handover of the project from the Bid Phase to the Project execution phase, upon winning the project.


**Use your skills to move the world forward!**
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering and a minimum 4 years engineering experience in EPC, engineering, manufacturing, utility, or industrial corporate environment.
* Advanced degrees may be substituted for 2 years of experience.
* Experience with the design and application of electrical power distribution products and power systems/ power delivery.
* Knowledge of the commercial terms used in Quotation process.
* Knowledge of relay P\&C schemes, schematics, communication network diagrams.
* Abilitymannersalyze customers’ technical documentation to interpret and apply appropriate Siemens product offerings to meet the customers’ expectations in cost\-effective and timely manner, offer alternative solutions to optimize profitability while meeting customer needs.
* Basic financial knowledge to understand and participate in ongoing business planning and support the product as well as project lifecycle management processes.
* Excellent collaboration, leadership, and decision\-making skills in a team environment, and demonstrated ability to perform and prioritize multiple, simultaneous tasks while maintaining excellent customer service.
* Excellent communications skills to effectively and accurately communicate with internal and external customers.
* Ability to identify market trends and using this information, work closely with Marketing and Technology to create and justify projects to close the identified gaps.
* Excellent PC skills including Microsoft Office tools and product configuration/pricing applications.
* Experience with Electrical and 2D Layout drawing tools such as AutoCad, Visio, etc.
* Travel Required – Less than 10%.


**Create a better \#TomorrowWithUs!**
 This role is based in Chennai, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries \- and the shape of things to come.
   

  

 We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
   

  

 We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M\+ buyers and suppliers. Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.


Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.


Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.


Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.


**The Impact of a Lead Cloud Platform Engineer at Coupa:**

As a Lead Cloud Platform Engineer at Coupa, you will be a technical leader and strategic architect who shapes the future of our cloud infrastructure and platform engineering practices, with a strong emphasis on Cloud Platform and quality engineering through automation. Your visionary approach will drive the design and implementation of scalable, resilient platform solutions that embed quality and reliability at every layer, enabling hundreds of engineers to deliver exceptional products with confidence. You'll establish technical standards that prioritize automated quality assurance, mentor engineering talent on quality\-first practices, and make critical architectural decisions that ensure robust, testable, and maintainable systems. Your leadership will be instrumental in transforming how we design, build, test, deploy, and operate cloud services with uncompromising quality standards, positioning Coupa as a technology leader known for platform reliability and engineering excellence..


### **What You’ll Do**


* **Lead Platform Architecture and Strategy:** Define and drive the long\-term technical vision for cloud platform infrastructure, making strategic decisions on technology choices, architectural patterns, and platform evolution
* **Design Enterprise\-Scale Platform Solutions:** Architect complex, multi\-tenant platform systems that support high availability, scalability, and security requirements across global cloud environments
* **Drive Technical Leadership and Mentorship:** Lead and mentor a team of platform engineers, providing technical guidance, code reviews, and career development while fostering a culture of engineering excellence
* **Establish Platform Engineering Standards:** Define and implement best practices, coding standards, and architectural principles that ensure consistency, reliability, and maintainability across all platform components
* **Build Advanced Automation and Tooling:** Design and develop sophisticated automation frameworks, self\-service platforms, and developer productivity tools that transform engineering workflows
* **Lead Critical Cross\-functional Initiatives:** Drive complex, multi\-team projects involving platform modernization, migration strategies, and infrastructure transformation initiatives
* **Optimize Platform Performance and Costs:** Analyze platform performance at scale, implement advanced monitoring and alerting solutions, and drive strategic cost optimization through FinOps leadership
* **Shape CI/CD and Release Engineering Strategy:** Define enterprise\-wide deployment strategies, release management processes, and continuous delivery practices that enable safe, rapid software delivery
* **Quality Engineering and Platform Quality \-** Own end\-to\-end quality strategy for platform and product releases, including test automation, performance, reliability, and release validation. Drive platform\-wide quality standards, CI/CD quality gates, observability, and proactive defect prevention to ensure scalable, secure, and high\-performing systems.
* **Drive Security and Compliance Architecture:** Lead the implementation of security\-first platform design, automated compliance frameworks, and risk mitigation strategies across cloud infrastructure
* **Influence Product and Engineering Strategy:** Collaborate with senior leadership to align platform capabilities with business objectives and product roadmap requirements
* **Champion Quality Innovation and Automation:** Research, evaluate, and integrate cutting\-edge quality engineering technologies, testing methodologies, and automation tools that advance Coupa's platform quality and reliability capabilities
* **Build Quality\-Focused Engineering Culture:** Contribute to technical decision\-making forums with a quality lens, lead quality\-focused architectural reviews, and promote quality engineering practices and knowledge sharing across the engineering organization

### **What You Will Bring to Coupa**


* **Senior Platform Engineering Leadership:** 10\+ years of hands\-on platform engineering experience with 3\+ years in technical leadership roles, including experience managing complex cloud infrastructure at enterprise scale
* **Advanced Cloud Architecture Expertise:** Deep expertise in cloud\-native architectures, multi\-cloud strategies, and advanced services across AWS, Azure, or GCP, with proven experience designing systems that handle millions of transactions
* **Technical Leadership and Team Building:** Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams, mentoring senior engineers, and driving technical decision\-making in complex, fast\-paced environments
* **Enterprise Platform Design:** Proven track record designing and implementing large\-scale platform solutions, including microservices architectures, container orchestration, and distributed systems patterns
* **Advanced Automation and Programming:** Expert\-level programming skills in multiple languages (Python, Go, Java, etc.) with extensive experience building sophisticated automation frameworks and platform tools
* **Strategic CI/CD and DevOps:** Deep expertise in enterprise CI/CD design, infrastructure as code, and DevOps transformation initiatives, with experience implementing these practices across large engineering organizations
* **FinOps \& Cost Engineering:** Advanced knowledge of cloud cost optimization, financial operations practices, and experience building cost management strategies and tooling at enterprise scale
* **Security and Compliance Leadership:** Strong background in security architecture, compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO27001, etc.), and implementing security practices in cloud environments

At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well\-being . We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:


**Global Well\-Being Perks (For All Employees Globally)**


* **Global Wellness Days:** Enjoy two designated, company\-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together .
* **Birthday Time\-Off:** Celebrate your day! Coupa provides a paid day off on your birthday or another day of your choice within your birthday month .
* **Volunteer Time Off (VTO):** Giving back is in our DNA. We offer 40 hours of paid VTO annually to support the community initiatives and volunteer programs you are passionate about .
* **Employee Assistance Program (EAP):** Access free, confidential, 24/7/365 counseling and resources for emotional support, work\-life solutions, financial advice, legal guidance, and support for new parents .
* **Business Travel Protection:** Travel with peace of mind. Zurich Travel Assist provides medical, safety, pre\-trip planning, and emergency support during any business travel .
* **Referral Bonus Program:** Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles .

*Please note: In addition to these global well\-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location\-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process.*

defa3f2e.title: Technical Account Manager
defa3f2e.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in a customer\-facing role working with stakeholders, driving customer technical implementations or transformation programs.
* Experience supporting customers in cloud operations (e.g., launch or capacity planning, product release management), technical support, escalation management, or consulting.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience translating business requirements into technological solutions.
* Experience in application or workload migration to public cloud providers.
* Experience collaborating with teams, groups, business units, channel partners, systems integrators, and third\-party developers to deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Understanding of IT operations, database systems, networking, IT security, application development, service architecture, cloud\-native application development, hosted services, storage systems, or content delivery networks.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.



As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help customers effectively adopt Google Cloud products. You will lead the integration of Google Cloud within organizations, guiding them through the strategic and technical facets of their transformation journey. You will also manage the delivery of Cloud Consulting engagements to drive long\-term customer adoption.  

  

In this role, you will regularly engage with various stakeholder groups, including enterprise leaders and cross\-functional, geographically dispersed teams.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Accelerate customer integration of Google Cloud by leading the implementation journey. Provide technical guidance and manage timelines, milestones, migration goals, and transformation strategies.
* Advocate for customer needs to overcome blockers and influence new feature development. Lead multiple workstreams to maintain momentum.
* Develop strategic relationships with stakeholders to understand business objectives, create roadmaps, and lead quarterly business reviews.
* Plan for customer events and launches by partnering with Support, Engineering, and Site Reliability teams to ensure success.
* Create best practices and assets based on customer engagements to scale initiatives through partners and accelerate cloud utilization.

Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team


NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It’s a place where passionate individuals come together to create the future of sport. We are unapologetic about who we are and what we’re after—bringing innovation and inspiration to every athlete\* in the world. We look for athletes who can push boundaries, elevate our potential and continue leading us to greatness. The next tastemakers, playmakers, risk takers and glue players. Are you game?


**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**
------------------------


You will be part of the Supply Chain \& Planning Technology (SCPT) Portfolio \& Operations team, helping establish and mature SCPT’s operational footprint in Nike’s India Technology Center (ITC). You will report to the Director, SCPT ITC Operations and work in close partnership with Domain Portfolio \& Operations Leaders to facilitate delivery within the Sub\-Domain you support. You will collaborate directly with Product and Engineering leaders, Program Operations peers, Portfolio team and Initiative Program Managers, across locations in India, the US, and Europe.


**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**
--------------------------


We are looking for a hands\-on operator with experience in a scaled environment who can help teams predictably plan, execute and continuously improve how work gets done.


The right person brings strong program operations discipline, practical agile delivery experience, and the ability to turn data and metrics into clear insights that help leaders make informed decisions. They are comfortable partnering in a matrixed environment, influencing through trust and clarity, and improving operating standards without adding unnecessary process.


* 7\+ years of experience in program operations, technical program management, delivery operations, agile delivery, or a related technology operations role.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant field, or equivalent combination of education, experience, and training.
* Demonstrated experience supporting agile teams and delivery practices, including practical use of tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Experience creating dashboards, reports, and communicating operating insights that provide transparency into team health, progress, risks, and delivery effectiveness.
* Strong facilitation skills, including experience supporting planning rhythms such as quarterly planning, retrospectives, and operational readouts.
* Proven ability to partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations leaders to identify friction, clarify accountability, and improve ways of working.
* Comfort operating across geographies, cultures, and time zones, with a collaborative style that builds connection and alignment across distributed teams.
* Curiosity and practical experience using automation or AI\-enabled tools to simplify work, improve consistency, and scale operational practices.
* Preferred: experience with supply chain and/or planning technology delivery.

**WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON**
-----------------------


You will champion delivery excellence across Supply Chain \& Planning Technology by driving consistent operating standards, delivery frameworks, and execution practices. Your work will provide clear visibility into team health, program execution, and operational effectiveness so leaders and teams can make better decisions, address risks sooner, and continuously improve how teams deliver.


**Sub\-Domain Delivery Partnership —** Operate in close partnership through a dotted line relationship with the Domain Portfolio \& Operations Leader to facilitate delivery within the sub\-domain and help translate operating standards into practical execution.


**Agile Tools and Standards —** Drive consistent use of agile tools, program standards, and delivery practices, including Jira, Confluence, and related operating mechanisms.


**Quarterly Planning Readiness —** Support the quarterly planning process and facilitation by ensuring teams are prepared, aligned, and set up for successful execution.


**Dashboards, Reporting, and Insights —** Create and maintain dashboards and reporting that provide transparency into team performance, progress, and risks; use insights to highlight gaps and drive improvements.


**Operational Improvement —** Actively surface inefficiencies or gaps in squad operations and work with teams to implement practical improvements that increase delivery effectiveness and predictability.


**Change Management —** Lead adoption and change management of new tools, processes, and ways of working so teams understand what is changing, why it matters, and how to apply it.


**Product and Engineering Partnership —** Co\-create and collaborate with Product and Engineering partners to evolve squad operating standards and agile ways of working.


**AI\-Enabled Ways of Working —** Identify and drive operational and process improvements that increase efficiency, consistency, and effectiveness across SCPT, using AI\-enabled tools to experiment, learn, and scale what works.


**Program Delivery Support —** Support program delivery within the sub\-domain on an ad\-hoc basis in alignment with the Domain Portfolio \& Operations Leader.


**Initiative Program Partnership —** Partner with Initiative Program Managers, where applicable, to facilitate delivery and support program objectives.


**Local Execution for Cross\-Domain Work —** Drive and support local execution of cross\-domain or SCPT\-wide programs during local business hours.
